- Complete additional vertical-specific training.
- Manage incoming leads alongside active opportunities, keep clients engaged through technical stages, and deliver against conversion and conversation-quality targets.
- Maintain a healthy, accurately forecast pipeline moving through your funnel.

- Have a solid history of claiming and closing new business by consistently meeting or exceeding both sales and quality expectations and targets.
- Identify where opportunities are losing momentum and improve your follow-through using evidence from your own work.
- Suggest process improvement areas to increase team efficiency and effectiveness, which may include providing consultation or advice to management on policies and procedures.

description:
About KIRA 

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

KIRA is building a AI Stockbroking Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Manager owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

Â 

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Â 

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Â 

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Senior Growth Product Manager AI Native
description:
About Magic Eden and Dicey 
Magic Eden reached unicorn status in just 9 months after launch, one of the fastest in history. We built a category-defining NFT marketplace from scratch and proved we know how to move fast. Now we're doing it again. Dicey is our crypto casino and sportsbook platform, targeting the $180B+ iGaming and sports betting markets.

We're a small, fully remote team. We ship fast, we're hands-on with our data, and we're rebuilding how a growth team operates around AI from the ground up.

The role 
Most of the iGaming industry competes on acquisition. Almost nobody has figured out personalized retention, knowing who a player is, what they need right now, and what would actually change their behavior this week. That's the problem you'll own.

This role focuses on the full post-signup journey: expanding our player segmentation framework, designing and running targeted offers and campaigns, and owning the P&L lever that comes with it. It's explicitly AI-native. You'll build workflows, agents, and pipelines to run lifecycle campaigns that would have taken a whole team two years ago. Half the job is identifying the right problem. The other half is running the experiments to find the answer.

What you'll do 

- Own retention and monetization as a growth loop. Set the targets, find the leverage, and drive the numbers for everything that happens after a player signs up

- Own the player segmentation framework. Today it's value and risk. You decide how it evolves, what signals feed it, and how the rest of the company uses it

- Build the AI-native growth stack. Analysis, agents, and automated pipelines that surface segments, generate offer candidates, and run campaigns with minimal manual work

- Design and ship targeted offers for specific segments and moments: reload bonuses, lossback, wager bounties, challenges, win-back sequences. Size them, spec them, ship them, measure them

- Spend real time in our data warehouse and on-chain data finding patterns and turn them into campaigns before anyone else does

- Expand the signals we have on players: on-chain activity, status-match programs, social account linking, and whatever else you can think of

- Run the campaigns. Email, in-app, Telegram, whatever the channel. You're hands-on with it, with AI doing the heavy lifting

- Partner with engineering and design to ship the product surfaces that make all of this repeatable

What we're looking for 

- Strong intuition for player psychology and incentive design. Experience in gambling, gaming, fintech, or consumer marketplaces helps. Genuine curiosity about why people behave the way they do is required

- Deeply analytical. You can go from a vague question to a clean cohort cut yourself, without waiting on a data scientist

- AI-native by default. You already use AI to write queries, build analyses, and automate your own work and you want to push that much further

- High output with good judgment. You generate a lot of ideas and know which ones are worth testing first

- Bias to do it yourself. You're comfortable sending the email, running the query, and writing the spec, not just briefing others

- Comfortable with ambiguity. There's no playbook here, you'll be building it

Backgrounds that tend to fit 

- Growth PM at a data-heavy consumer company

- MBB consultant who wants to move into product and own outcomes, not just advise on them

- Product Minded Data scientist or analyst who wants to ship, not just report

Why this is interesting 

- Competitive, top-of-market compensation

- You're defining what a growth PM looks like in an AI-native company, there's no inherited playbook

- Personalised retention is where the industry is going and we're building it early

- Real ownership: a segmentation framework, a product surface, and a P&L lever, with a direct line to the founding team

title: Frontend Engineer
description:
About ActAI 

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting. Our application focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations

Our objective is to organise anyone's life.

Â 

Role 

As a Web Frontend Engineer, you will build the core web experiences, including Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

You will own complex, highly interactive product surfaces from architecture through implementation, working closely with product, design, backend and AI engineers to make AI a native part of how users communicate, write, organise and work.

Â 

What You'll Own

- Build major web experiences across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs, and Sheets.

- Develop complex interactions including real-time messaging, collaborative editing, rich-text editing, scheduling, tables, and spreadsheets.

- Build reusable frontend architecture and components that work consistently across ActAI applications.

- Integrate streaming AI responses, proactive actions, and model-driven experiences directly into product workflows.

- Own frontend performance, responsiveness, reliability and accessibility across browsers and devices.

- Work closely with product and design to take ideas from prototype to production quickly.

Â 

What We're Looking For

- Strong experience building complex, production web applications using React, TypeScript and modern frontend technologies.

- Deep understanding of frontend architecture, state management, browser APIs, and performance.

- Experience building highly interactive products such as chat, collaboration, productivity, document editing, calendars, or workspaces.

- Experience with real-time systems, WebSockets, streaming APIs, or collaborative interfaces.

- Strong product and UI judgment with attention to interaction details.

- Able to independently own features from technical design through production.

Â 

Outcomes 

- Users can communicate, write, organise and collaborate seamlessly across Chat, Notes, Calendar, Docs and Sheets.

- Complex interactions such as group messaging, editing, scheduling and collaboration feel fast and reliable.

- AI capabilities are integrated naturally into product workflows rather than added as separate chatbot experiences.

- Frontend architecture remains fast, maintainable and reusable as ActAI expands into new applications and workflows.

Â 

Tech Stack 

- TypeScript

- React.js / Next.js

- HTML / CSS

- WebSockets / streaming APIs

- Node.js

- REST / GraphQL APIs

Â 

How We Work 

The best products today in the world were built by small, world-class teams. We are a high talent density and hands-on team. We make decisions collectively and move at rapid speed, striking a balance between shipping high-quality work and learning.

Joining our team requires the ability to bring structure, exercise judgment and execute independently. Our goal is to put in the hands of our users a truly magical product.

Â 

Interview Process 

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us and help bring practical AI benefits to billions of users globally.

title: Software Deployment Engineer
description:
About KPI Solutions KPI Solutions is a national supply chain consulting and warehouse automation systems integrator, helping some of the biggest names in e-commerce, retail, and distribution move product faster and smarter. Formed in 2021 through the combination of Kuecker Logistics Group, PULSE Integration, and QC Software, KPI brings together decades of material handling and systems integration experience â rooted in material handling integration dating back to 1971. From initial design through go-live and ongoing support, KPI delivers engineered solutions that blend automated technologies (MHE, robotics, conveyor, ASRS, AMR/AGV) with intelligent warehouse execution software to optimize productivity, increase fulfillment speed, and build operational resilience for clients.

Position SummaryÂ 

The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is an individual-contributor role responsible for the end-to-end delivery, configuration, installation, and support of Kommand warehouse execution/control systems and related material handling hardware (pick-to-light, overhead illuminators, AutoStore, and T-sort integrations). This role owns project-level system configuration, commissioning, installation, upgrade, and live troubleshooting work independently, with minimal oversight, across both on-site and remote/office phases of the project lifecycle. It combines software commissioning, hardware coordination, database scripting, environment configuration, and formal test/sign-off responsibilities that have historically been distributed across multiple roles and a dedicated installation team.Â 

This position carries broadened scope following the consolidation of hardware installation and commissioning functions previously performed by a dedicated Systems Integration & Commissioning (SI&C) team, which has since been dissolved. The Software Deployment Engineer I/II is expected to operate as the primary and, in several functions, sole point of ownership for the responsibilities outlined below.Â 

Key ResponsibilitiesÂ 

On-Site DeliveryÂ

- Own full-scope installation of pick-to-light systems, including wiring, physical installation, configuration, and functional testing â a scope absorbed from the former SI&C team.Â 
- Own full-scope installation of overhead illuminator systems, following the same end-to-end responsibility as above.Â 
- Conduct IQ (Installation Qualification) and UAT (User Acceptance Testing) following installation, including preparation of formal test documentation and customer sign-off.Â 
- Serve as the sole owner of Kommand and system-level troubleshooting for live, in-production issues during on-site engagements.Â 
Remote / Office DeliveryÂ 

- Independently deliver new Kommand installations, including application pre-configuration, database scripting, and pre-deployment testing. Sole personnel on this workstream, currently managing 4 upcoming and 1 active installation.Â 
- Independently deliver Kommand version upgrades, including SSDT (SQL Server Data Tools) schema comparisons, version control, local pre-install testing, and direct customer coordination. Sole personnel on this workstream, with approximately 22 major upgrades planned in the current year.Â 
- Production upgrade execution is performed after standard business hours to minimize customer downtime.Â 
- DEV, QA, and Sandbox environment work is performed during standard business hours.Â 
- Validate, diagnose, and remediate reported defects; route confirmed fixes to QA prior to merge and deployment. Escalation to other engineering resources is rare.Â 
- Participate in the on-call rotation covering Kommand, AutoStore, and T-sort system escalations.Â 
- Provide post-go-live project support on an as-needed basis, including system migrations (e.g., bin/location migrations), integration testing with customer ERP/WMS platforms (e.g., SAP/WMS), and multi-site rollout support.Â 
Project Configuration & DeploymentÂ 

- Gather all Kommand configurations and system parameters required for a given project.Â 
- Translate the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and customer conversations into the Kommand system settings spreadsheet, network spreadsheet, and system parameters.Â 
- Educate the client on use of the host interface.Â 
- Not required for all projects â dependent on whether the customer's integration involves interface changes (e.g., AutoCase, Pack & Hold).Â 
- Configure the client's Kommand sandbox environment to be project-specific for customer testing, and support the client through that testing.Â 
- Configure the Kommand production environment ahead of go-live.Â 
- Assist with training on any new features requiring customer or internal education.Â 
Scope & IndependenceÂ 

This role currently operates as the sole owner of several critical workstreams, including all new Kommand installations, all Kommand upgrade delivery, and all live Kommand/system troubleshooting. The role requires the judgment and technical depth to manage customer-facing delivery, testing, and sign-off without a dedicated support team, and to make sound decisions under time pressure during after-hours production changes and live escalations.Â 

- Demonstrated experience commissioning warehouse execution/control software and associated hardware peripherals.Â 
- Working knowledge of SQL Server-based application environments, including SSDT schema comparison and version control practices.Â 
- Experience with formal software testing methodology (IQ/UAT), including documentation and customer sign-off processes.Â 
- Ability to independently diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve live production issues under time pressure.Â 
- Comfort with hands-on installation work (wiring, hardware configuration) for pick-to-light and overhead illumination systems, or willingness/ability to develop this competency.Â 
- Willingness to work after hours and participate in an on-call rotation.Â 
- Ability to translate business requirements documentation and customer conversations into structured system configuration (settings, network, and parameter specifications).Â 
- Strong customer-facing communication skills; comfortable coordinating directly with customer stakeholders during upgrades, go-live support, and system/interface training.Â 
Preferred QualificationsÂ 

- Prior experience with AutoStore and/or T-sort systems.Â 
- Experience with ERP/WMS integration testing (e.g., SAP).Â 
- Background in material handling, warehouse automation, or industrial controls environments.Â 

What we Offer:

Why KPI Solutions?

At KPI Solutions, youâll be part of a team that values innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement. This is more than a reporting roleâitâs an opportunity to make a measurable impact on project success and business performance.

Why Now

If you want to own monetization end-to-end rather than manage an approval queue, this role is built for it.

description:
About KIRA 

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

Â 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Â 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role 

KIRA is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

Â 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

Â 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end , from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

Â 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

Â 

What You'll Own 

- Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

- Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

- Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

- Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

- Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

- Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

- Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

Â 

What We're Looking For 

- 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

- Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

- Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

- Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

- Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

- Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Â 

Nice to have 

- Engineering or highly technical product background.

- Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

- Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Â 

Outcome 

- Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

- Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

- Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

- AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

- Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

- Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role . We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones. 

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

- Online assessment or practical task

- Technical interview

- CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Blackbird Interactive is looking for an experienced Senior Level Designer to help build and deliver high-quality gameplay spaces for an action RPG focused on fast-paced combat, character progression, exploration, and replayability. This role focuses on designing levels, encounters, and environments that create satisfying combat opportunities, reward exploration, and support a wide variety of player builds and abilities.

-

Requirements

A minimum of 8 years of game development experience, with significant experience designing and implementing levels for action, RPG, or combat focused games

- 
Experience shipping multiple titles, including at least one in a senior or equivalent level design role

- 
Proven ability to independently own complex levels from initial concept and blockout through implementation, iteration, and final polish

- 
Strong understanding of action RPG level design, including combat spaces, encounter pacing, exploration, progression, player guidance, and replayability

- 
Strong hands-on experience with level editing, gameplay scripting, and in-engine implementation, with the ability to prototype, debug, and iterate quickly

- 
Strong design judgment, communication, and collaboration skills, with the ability to balance gameplay quality, creative goals, technical constraints, and production realities

Pluses

Passion for action RPGs centered on combat, character builds, loot, progression, and exploration

- 
Experience designing levels for an isometric or elevated gameplay camera, with an understanding of its impact on combat readability, navigation, and composition

- 
Experience creating replayable content that supports different character builds, abilities, difficulty levels, or repeated playthroughs

title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
description:
Overview 

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale. 

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

- Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

- The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

- Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

- We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

- A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

- Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

- You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

- A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

- Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

- Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

- Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work 

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation 

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

- Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes. 
- Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements. 
- Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed. 
- Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise. 
- Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility. 
- Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port. 
- Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures. 

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

- Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
- Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
- Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work. 
- Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required. 

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

- Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy. 
- Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations. 
- Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format. 
- Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities. 
- Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work. 
- Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery. 
- Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise. 
- Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions. 
- Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others. 
- Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems. 

Physical Requirements:

- Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory. 
- The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively. 
- The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential. 
- Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment. 
- Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling. 
- The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities. 
- Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs. 
- The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required. 
- Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required. 

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

location: New York, New York, New York, United States
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering , Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

- Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security. 
- Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation. 
- Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do. 
- Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
- Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it. 
- Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team. 

What You'll Bring

- Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth. 
- Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook. 
- An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code. 
- Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling. 
- Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you. 
- Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus. 
- Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus. 

What's Cool About The Role

- You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team. 
- A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders. 
- We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it. 
- Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity. 
- Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas. 
- Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook. 

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Our platform helps businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently while seamlessly connecting design, production, and delivery for teams creating architectural millwork, cabinetry, and casework.

What truly sets INNERGY apart is our people. Founded in 2016, we are a globally distributed team of 200 plus professionals united by deep software expertise and a shared passion for solving meaningful, real world problems. We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

We're looking for a versatile, hands-on Marketing Specialist who thrives as a generalist and can move fluidly between product marketing content, web production, and performance channels. You'll be the kind of marketer who can write a compelling product page in the morning, build and publish it in WordPress over lunch, and optimize a paid search and social campaign by the afternoon. You're equally comfortable thinking about messaging and positioning as you are reading a CPL report.

This is a high-impact role for someone who wants ownership across the funnel and the chance to directly influence pipeline at a fast-growing vertical SaaS company. If you like wearing multiple hats, learning a niche industry deeply, and seeing your work drive measurable results, you'll fit right in.

Product & content marketing

- Write and produce marketing content across formats â landing pages, web copy, emails, case studies, one-pagers, ad copy, and campaign assets. 
- Partner with product and sales to keep positioning sharp and messaging consistent across the buyer journey. 

Web production (WordPress)

- Build, edit, and publish web pages in WordPress â from landing pages to product and resource pages â with an eye for layout, conversion, and on-page experience. 
- Maintain and improve the website over time: updating content, fixing issues, A/B testing, and ensuring pages stay fast, on-brand, and conversion-ready. 

Paid social & paid search

- Plan, launch, manage, and optimize paid campaigns across search (Google Ads) and social (LinkedIn, Meta, and others as relevant). 
- Own day-to-day campaign management: audiences, creative, budgets, bidding, and ongoing testing to improve cost-per-lead and ROAS. 
- Report on performance and translate results into clear next steps. 

Demand generation

- Support full-funnel demand gen programs that drive leads and pipeline â across email, webinars, events, content syndication, and nurture.

- Track and report on funnel metrics, contributing to a continuous test-and-learn culture. 

Knowledge and Preferred Qualifications:

Qualifications

title: Managing Director (m/f/d) - Focus on Accounting & Office
description:
This role is part of our Central Finance Team at saas.group. 

What is saas.group? 

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 400+ colleagues spanning 45 countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 24 exciting brands under our umbrella. Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview 

We are looking for a hands-on, detail-oriented Managing Director to lead SaaS.group GmbH, our German legal entity based in Schönefeld . In this role, you will serve as the registered Managing Director on-site, exercising real decision-making authority, managing office administration, and overseeing day-to-day accounting operations . You will serve as the local face of the company for authorities, banks, auditors, and external service providers while working in close alignment with our Central Legal, Accounting, and Finance teams . 

This is a unique opportunity for an experienced finance or office management professional based in the Berlin/Brandenburg region looking to step up into an official corporate leadership role within an international, fast-growing software group . 

Your immediate impact in the first 3-6 months will be:

- Seamlessly transition into the registered Managing Director role for SaaS.group GmbH and establish effective on-site operational processes in Schönefeld . 

- Assume complete oversight of local bookkeeping (payables, receivables, document management) and streamline month-end close workflows . 

- Build strong working relationships with our external tax advisors, auditors, banks, and internal group accounting/legal functions . 

- Ensure full compliance with all corporate-law requirements, commercial register obligations, and internal rules of procedure . 

Your responsibilities 

- Manage SaaS.group GmbH on-site in Schönefeld, taking full ownership of approvals, contract execution, and payment authorizations within defined rules of procedure . 

- Run and oversee day-to-day bookkeeping, including accounts payable/receivable, document organization, and preparation of month-end closing activities . 

- Collaborate closely with tax advisors and auditors on VAT filings, annual financial statements, and audit processes . 

- Maintain strict compliance with German corporate-law obligations, including commercial register filings, transparency register updates, and shareholder resolutions . 

- Lead office management and operational setup in Schönefeld, managing incoming mail, vendor/service provider contracts, archiving, and filing systems . 

- Act as the primary local point of contact for the German tax office (Finanzamt), financial institutions, local authorities, and insurers . 

What You bring to the table 

- Vocational training in a commercial field (e.g., Tax Clerk / Steuerfachangestellte/r, Certified Accountant / Bilanzbuchhalter/in, Office Management) or equivalent practical experience . 

- Multi-year background in accounting, financial administration, or senior office management . 

- Strong proficiency with DATEV (or comparable accounting software) as well as modern digital tools (MS Office / Google Workspace) . 

- Fluency in German and good working proficiency in English to collaborate effectively across our international group . 

- Willingness to assume corporate liability and responsibility as a registered Managing Director (leadership experience is a plus, but not required) . 

- Residence in the Berlin/Brandenburg region with the requirement for regular, physical presence at our Schönefeld office . 

What's in it for You 

- Real Responsibility: A genuine Managing Director role with clear rules of procedure, corporate protection (D&O insurance included), and direct collaboration with the group CFO . 

- Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.

- Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.

- Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.

- Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally. 

- Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies. 

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. If you're passionate about working with a team that values innovation, excellence, and fairness, we encourage you to apply. 

We believe in fair and transparent pay. Salary ranges at saas.group are location-adjusted, targeting local market medians for a remote-first environment, and will be shared with our potential future employees in writing before your first interview - so you have everything you need to evaluate the opportunity.

title: Solutions Engineer UAS / Aviation
description:
We’re looking for a Solutions Engineer UAS / Aviation who will play a pivotal role in the future of our company. Our Solutions Engineer will be responsible for the integration, validation, and operational readiness of Auterion-powered drone systems. - Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges

- Perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 and/or other autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up

- Execute End-of-Line (EoL) software validation and functional testing to ensure production readiness and reliability

- Interface with external vendors and equipment providers to support testing infrastructure, hardware integration, and operational readiness

- Participate in hands-on flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance

Qualifications and Skills 

- B.Sc. in Aviation Technology, Robotics, Embedded Systems, Electrical Engineering, or related field (M.Sc. optional)

- Hands-on experience working with Autopilot, Mission planning and navigation Software, including firmware flashing, configuration, and flight validation

- Strong technical foundation in embedded systems, firmware debugging, and hardware-software integration

- Proficiency in C/C++ and/or MAVLink communication protocols or equivalent Datalink protocols

- Experience with UAV sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and flight controller configuration

- Familiarity with Linux-based development and debugging environments

- Experience with UAV flight testing, system validation, and troubleshooting in real-world operational environments

- Understanding of drone manufacturing, QC processes, and End-of-Line testing methodologies is a plus

- Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with cross-functional engineering and operations teams

- Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments with evolving technical challenges

- Passion for drone technology and a hands-on engineering mindset focused on building reliable flying systems

- EU citizenship required 

About Auterion 

We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems. 

At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.

title: Growth Associate (Intern)
description:
Who we are 

Melotech is revolutionizing media and entertainment. We create art through technology for humans to enjoy. In just 24 months, our work has been heard, watched and loved for over 4 billion minutes worldwide.

Founded by entrepreneur and investor Soheil Mirpour, we are backed by top VCs Cherry Ventures, Speedinvest and GFC, alongside world-class angels from firms such as Spotify, Blackstone and KKR.

What you will do 

Melotech is scaling fast, and organic reach is one of the engines behind it. As Growth Associate (Intern), you help run that engine end to end: the creators, the formats, the trends and the numbers behind them. This is an organic growth role first, measured on how much reach every hour and every euro brings back. You work directly with our founders, our Growth Manager, product and data team.

Today that means a steady stream of new products that each deserve a shot at going viral across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts. Your first job is to build the machine behind that: find the creators and communities that move culture, turn what works into repeatable playbooks, and run more experiments in a week than most teams run in a quarter.

On a typical day, your tasks may include:

- Creator network: finding, briefing and paying creators and pages at scale, from small accounts with loyal audiences to the ones that set trends, and keeping the ones that deliver

- Seeding: getting our products into the formats and communities where they can travel, at the right moment and in the right volume

- Trend spotting: catching formats and memes early and moving on them within days, not weeks

- Experiments: running many cheap tests every week, with clear rules for what wins and what gets killed, and turning the winners into playbooks the team can repeat

- New channels: finding places where attention is still cheap, from fan pages and communities to platforms nobody on the team is using yet

- Organic and paid together: working with our Growth Manager so organic winners get scaled with paid, and what paid learns feeds back into organic

- Measurement: knowing which number answers which question, for example what saves and shares tell you that views do not, and what each view really costs

- Tooling: building the trackers, scripts and automations you need, with platform data and AI tools as your daily coworkers

Who you are 

We're looking for a student or recent graduate who lives on the platforms and wants to learn how to make content travel.

Typically, your profile will look like this:

- Platform fluency: you know TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts well and can explain why a post performs

- Hands-on experience: you have grown an account, a page or a side project, or supported a startup or brand on social

- Creator marketing: you enjoy working with creators and have a feel for content that looks native

- Creativity: you bring fresh ideas and test them in a structured way

- Analytical: you are comfortable with numbers and spreadsheets; SQL, Python or AI tools are a plus

- Pace: you thrive in a fast-paced and performance-oriented environment

- A big plus: you are a creator yourself, or have run pages with a real following

- Academics: pursuing or recently graduated with a degree at a top-tier university, with an outstanding academic record: grades, scholarships or awards to show for it

What makes this exciting 

You own a lever the whole company feels. Every breakout you engineer shows up directly in how fast we can grow, at a fraction of what paid reach would cost. You're not a cog in the machine but the captain of your own ship, rewarded for performance and respected for leadership. Flat hierarchies mean that your voice matters, your ideas get implemented, and your impact is immediate.

We pay competitive salaries and make you an owner of the business with equity. We work remotely to give you complete freedom over your life, while meeting regularly around the world for global offsites where we strategize, bond, and push boundaries together.

What the process will look like 

We hire on a rolling basis. Earliest starting date is always ASAP.

Once you begin our process, you can progress from start to offer within a week, depending on how quickly you can move through each stage:

- Initial interview: 30-minute introductory call, getting to know you

- Case interview: 90-minute case discussion, present and debate your skills

- Founder interview: 90-minute interview with our CEO, going deep on all topics

- Offer, contract signing and onboarding

Note: As we are still in stealth, you will learn more about Melotech as you progress through the stages. By the end of the Founder interview, you will have a full grasp of our business and the details of your role.

title: Account Executive, Germany
description:
About Wayflyer 

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

You'll be collaborating with ambitious colleagues from around the world. We have offices in Dublin, London, New York, Charlotte, Berlin and Sydney.

The challenge 

There are thousands of businesses globally growing fast and hitting the same wall - they need capital, and traditional lenders are too slow, too rigid, or simply not interested. We've already deployed over $6bn to growing businesses like these. The opportunity in front of us is significant, and we need people who can capitalise on it.

What you'll actually do 

You'll own the full sales cycle from sourcing your own leads to closing deals with some of the most exciting consumer brands in Germany. You'll run in-depth discovery calls using MEDDPICC, work closely with our underwriting team to move fast without cutting corners, and negotiate deals that genuinely work for both sides. You'll have a dedicated BDR alongside you, but you won't wait around for a full pipeline to land in your lap. The best AEs here source relentlessly, close confidently, and treat their customers like business partners, not transactions. Top performers are hitting ~200% of target. That's not a boast. It's a signal of what’s possible.

What this role could turn into 

Account Executives at Wayflyer tend to grow in one of two directions - first on the ground in one of our emerging verticals, or into team leadership as we scale. We're continuing to launch new products and verticals, which means the people who perform here will have real options. We'd rather promote from within than hire from outside, and our track record reflects that.

Who thrives here 
You've worked a full sales cycle before, and you didn't just hit your number; you understood exactly why you hit it and what to do differently when you didn't. You source your own pipeline without being asked, and you don't wait for perfect conditions to start. You're energised by ambiguity, not paralysed by it. You push deals forward when others would wait for a signal. When a sceptical founder pushes back, you lean in. You've been told "no" and come back with a better question. You care about eCommerce and small business growth, not as a line on a cover letter, but as a genuine reason you want this job.

We hire for range 
Full sales cycle experience across a range of deal values (think: $10K to 100K) in SaaS or FinTech, ideally with time spent as an outbound BDR/SDR. You know what it takes to build a pipeline from scratch, not just work it. A consistent track record of exceeding targets matters more than tenure. Resilience shows up in your history: you've had a bad quarter, figured out why, and bounced back stronger. MEDDPICC familiarity is required, and you'll need to speak German fluently. Startup or scale-up experience helps; the pace here is real, the playbook is still being written, and we need people who see that as an opportunity, not a risk.

Location and working policy 

📍 Berlin, hybrid (3-4 days per week in the office)

The good stuff 

25 days off, plus public holidays. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
description:
hellomed ist die digitale Pflege-Apotheke für Pflegekräfte - nach dem Motto: Dauermedikation nur in einfach!

Unsere Vision ist es, bis 2030 die jährlichen 250.000 Krankenhauseinlieferungen aufgrund von Medikationsfehlern und die damit verbundenen 1,2 Milliarden Euro Folgekosten zu vermeiden und der Pflege wieder zurückzugeben.

Mit unserer innovativen hellomedOS-Software für das Pflegepersonal entlasten wir Pflegekräfte bei der täglichen Medikationsversorgung ihrer Patienten und machen diese noch sicherer. Unser revolutionäres Konzept bringen wir mit einem bunten Team aus Apothekern, Pflegeexperten und Entwicklern auf die Straße - namhafte Investoren sind bereits mit an Bord und Pflegekräfte deutschlandweit lieben das Produkt. Erfinde gemeinsam mit uns die Medikationsversorgung in der Pflege von Morgen komplett neu!

Für unsere größten Kunden – Träger und Pflegeunternehmen mit mehreren Standorten – suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die diese Partnerschaften betreut, ausbaut und unsere Kundenbetreuung mit uns gemeinsam weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben

- Großkunden betreuen: Du betreust unsere größten Pflegeunternehmen und Träger – von der Einführung bis zur langfristigen Zusammenarbeit – und bist feste Ansprechperson für Geschäftsführungen, Regional- und Pflegedienstleitungen.

- Versorgung im Alltag sichern: Du sorgst dafür, dass alle vereinbarten Patienten auch tatsächlich über hellomed versorgt werden, und schulst Pflegeteams und Leitungen im sicheren Umgang mit hellomedOS – vor Ort und digital.

- Kundenbeziehungen ausbauen: Du erkennst, wo wir bei bestehenden Kunden weitere Standorte und Patienten versorgen können, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Vertrieb um. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich im Wachstum deiner Kundenbeziehungen.

- Gespräche auf Leitungsebene: Du führst regelmäßige Gespräche mit den Geschäftsführungen deiner Kunden – was läuft gut, wo gibt es Potenzial, was braucht der Kunde als Nächstes?

- Kundenbetreuung mitgestalten: Gemeinsam mit den Gründern entwickelst du unsere Abläufe in der Kundenbetreuung weiter und gibst deine Erfahrung an Kollegen im Team weiter.

- Verantwortung übernehmen: Mit wachsendem Team übernimmst du zunehmend Verantwortung für unsere gesamte Customer-Success-Funktion.

- Mit deiner Arbeit hilfst du dabei, unsere Vision zu verwirklichen und die Medikationsversorgung in der Pflege nachhaltig zu verbessern.

Qualifikation

- Berufserfahrung: Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Betreuung oder im Ausbau von Geschäftskunden mit, zum Beispiel als Key Account Manager, Kundenbetreuer oder im Vertrieb, idealerweise im Gesundheitswesen. Alternativ hast du Leitungserfahrung in der Pflege (z. B. als Pflegedienst-, Einrichtungs- oder Regionalleitung) und Freude an Kundenkontakt und Wachstum.

- Erfahrung mit großen Kunden: Du hast bereits Kunden mit mehreren Standorten betreut und trittst gegenüber Geschäftsführungen sicher und überzeugend auf.

- Kommunikationsstärke: Du erklärst komplexe Sachverhalte klar und verständlich und baust schnell Vertrauen auf – bei Pflegekräften ebenso wie bei Geschäftsführern.

- Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest zuverlässig und organisiert, behältst auch bei mehreren großen Kunden den Überblick und hast ein gutes Gespür für Zahlen.

- Technische Offenheit: Du arbeitest sicher mit digitalen Anwendungen. Erfahrung mit einem CRM-System oder Pflegesoftware ist von Vorteil.

- Reisebereitschaft: Du besuchst unsere Kunden regelmäßig vor Ort (max. 1/3 der Arbeitszeit).

- Haltung statt Lebenslauf: Startup-Erfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung – entscheidend sind deine Erfahrung und dein Anspruch an gute Kundenbetreuung.

Benefits

- Wir bieten dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag mit Arbeitsplatz in unserem brandneuen Büro am Mehringdamm im Herzen Berlin-Kreuzbergs, mit guter Verkehrsanbindung.

title: Director, European Government Operations
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB 

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity's reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

DIRECTOR – EUROPEAN GOVERNMENT OPERATIONS 

As the Director – European Government Operations, based in Munich/ Berlin, Germany, you will lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy across Germany and the broader European region. You will play a critical role in advancing Rocket Lab's business objectives by shaping policy environments, building strategic government relationships, and ensuring alignment between Government Affairs and Business Development. In this role, you will work at the intersection of aerospace innovation, national security, and European public-sector engagement. To be successful, you must be results‑oriented, proactive, politically astute, and deeply comfortable operating in complex, fast‑moving environments. Join a driven team of pioneers relentlessly tackling challenging projects, delivering on the impossible, and making an impact on the future of space.

WHAT YOU'LL GET TO DO 

- Build and lead Rocket Lab's in‑house European Government Operations function, delivering the same level of strategic support and government engagement the company receives in the U.S. market

- Develop and lead Rocket Lab's government affairs strategy in Germany and across Europe, ensuring alignment with corporate priorities and business development objectives

- Build and maintain high‑impact relationships with key German federal stakeholders, including the Bundestag, DLR, Ministry of Defense, and relevant regulatory and executive agencies

- Establish and grow Rocket Lab's presence with government entities and innovation ecosystems in Munich and other strategic European hubs

- Partner closely with the Business Development team to support market expansion, customer engagement, and pursuit of government‑funded programs

- Shape and influence policy discussions related to space, defense, launch, and emerging technologies, ensuring Rocket Lab's interests are represented and understood

- Provide strategic guidance on political, regulatory, and industrial‑policy developments across Europe, identifying opportunities and risks for business

- Represent Rocket Lab in industry associations, working groups, and public‑sector forums to strengthen the company's visibility and credibility

- Drive measurable business outcomes through targeted government engagement not only monitoring policy trends but actively shaping them

- Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on European political dynamics, defense priorities, and government procurement pathways

YOU'LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS 

- Bachelor's degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, economics, engineering, or a related field

- 12+ years of experience in government affairs, public policy, defense, aerospace, or related strategic roles within Germany or Europe

- Professional fluency in German and English

- Demonstrated success building and managing relationships with senior government officials, policymakers, and public‑sector institutions

- Proven ability to drive business‑aligned outcomes through government engagement, not solely policy monitoring

- Strong understanding of European political structures, defense priorities, and government procurement processes

- Ability to operate autonomously, set strategy, and execute in a fast‑paced, high‑growth environment

- Exceptional communication, negotiation, and stakeholder‑management skills

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE 

- Background in space, aerospace, defense, or dual‑use technology sectors

- Experience working with or within institutions such as DLR, MOD, Bundestag committees, EU defense bodies, or national innovation agencies

- Prior roles in business development, defense industrial policy, or public‑sector consulting

- Experience working in Munich's government, defense, or technology ecosystem

- Familiarity with NATO, EU defense initiatives, and cross‑border industrial‑cooperation frameworks

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas .

WHAT TO EXPECT 

We're on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that's not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other's backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way. 

Important information:

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY: 

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here . 

Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. 

Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at 

FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY: 

For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations. 

Under these Regulations, you may be ineligible for this role if you do not hold citizenship of Australia, Japan, New Zealand, Switzerland, the European Union, or a country that is part of NATO, or if you hold ineligible dual citizenship or nationality. For more information on these Regulations, click here ITAR Regulations.

title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:
About Wolt 

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life. 

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing 

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

- Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

- Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

- Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

- Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive 

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

- Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.

- You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.

- You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.

- You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.

- You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

- You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

- You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. 

Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash .

title: DSP Engineer - Werkstudent
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good. 

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

This is a hands-on opportunity to apply what you're learning about signal processing to a real product that keeps people and critical infrastructure safe. As a Working Student on our RF Engineering team in Kassel, you'll work alongside experienced DSP engineers — prototyping algorithms, analyzing real RF captures, and building the tooling that helps us detect and classify drones in the wild. You'll grow your practical DSP and software skills on real-world data, with mentorship and room to take ownership of meaningful pieces of work.

What You'll Do

Work Location: This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation.
