title: Engineering Manager – Robot Intelligence
description:
About the Role at RobCo 

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works. 

We are now looking for an ambitious Engineering Manager - Robot Intelligence (m/f/d) to help us establish RobCo as a leading provider of autonomous automation solutions.

In this key role, you will lead the “brain” of our autonomous robots - the physical AI harness that works with different models and skills. Managing a full-stack team of software and machine learning engineers, you will balance applied research with business value delivery on a daily basis. 

Your mission is to translate the latest advancements in physical AI foundation models and complex robotic functionality into a stable, scalable product that thrives in real-world factory environments. 

Your Responsibilities: 

- Drive Engineering Excellence: Set rigorous standards for code quality, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines to ensure 24/7 reliability of our robots.

- Lead Senior Talent: Act as a people-first leader for a team of Senior and Staff engineers, fostering a culture of high ownership and steady delivery.

- Bridge Software and Hardware: Oversee the lifecycle of products spanning from ML training, AI inference to Linux-based industrial interfaces.

- Balance Research and Delivery: Establish a strong applied research and experimentation culture, and build a process where the results directly contribute to delivery and practical outcomes.

- Management Framework: Work with real-time metrics and steer the team to continuously improve productivity, predictability and quality of what we ship.

- Operational Governance: Manage technical debt and architectural health to ensure long-term system stability as we scale.

- Strategic Alignment: Partner with Product Management to transform customer needs into concrete technical requirements and actionable sprints.

- Cross-Team Leadership: Mentor junior EMs and help evolve company-wide engineering best practices and software-first principles.

We are looking for someone who has: 

- Completed a university degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, Data Science or a related field.

- 3+ years of experience leading high-performing teams in complex technical environments like robotics or industrial IoT.

- Deep experience with AI and machine learning, including dataset curation, model training and optimization techniques and hands on experience building agentic harnesses.

- Proven track record of driving an AI-first engineering culture and implementing agentic workflows that measurably accelerate team velocity and system efficiency.

- Expert knowledge in modern SDLC practices, with a track record of improving deployment frequency and system stability.

- Culture-aligned mindset characterized by hardware empathy, a passion for software-defined hardware, and a strong culture of high ownership.

- Strong experience with full-stack software development, robotics engineering is a big plus.

- Very good English skills with the ability to navigate complex architectural discussions with Staff engineers while clearly communicating risks to stakeholders.

Why join RobCo? 

- Develop modular, software-defined robotics solutions with us that set new standards in automation.

- Help us build robots equipped with state-of-the-art AI that perceive their environment, analyze data, and make intelligent decisions in real time.

- As part of a very dynamic and fast-growing scale-up, you will take on responsibility from day one, drive your own projects, and see the direct impact of your work.

- Flat hierarchies, open communication, and regular 360° feedback enable fast decisions and support your professional and personal development.

- Wellpass membership (7,200+ studios across Germany), regular team events, and a team that takes both the work and the culture seriously.

- Flexible working hours, a modern office, and - depending on the role - the option to work from home.

- Regular team events - from relaxed beer & pizza nights on the rooftop terrace to shared experiences on ski trips or at Oktoberfest.

About RobCo 

Founded in Munich in 2020, RobCo leads the transition toward fully Autonomous Industrial Robotics. Our mission is to deploy RobCo in every factory - solving the industrial labor shortage through end-to-end robotics that just works. Powered by Physical AI, our solutions combine a scalable modular hardware architecture with intelligent software that adapts to your use case, improves over time, and requires zero upfront investment through our Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) model.

We solve our customers' most pressing pain points - labor shortage, cost pressure, workplace safety, and national reshoring - across the full spectrum of Autonomous Industrial Robotics. With $160M raised from investors including Lightspeed, Lingotto Innovation, and Sequoia, 200+ people globally, and 2.5M+ operating hours in the field, we are deploying robots in factories across Europe and the United States - with our US operations headquartered in Austin, TX, and our RobCo Bay Area Demo Lab in San Francisco.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. 

At RobCo, applicants are selected regardless of ethnic origin, religion, gender, age, disability, or sexual orientation. All decisions throughout the recruitment process are based solely on applicants’ qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience, as well as relevant business requirements.

title: Senior QA Engineer - Berlin
description:
About RA 

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

Purpose of the role 

As our Senior QA Engineer, you'll look after the quality of ra.co , our iOS and Android apps, and RA Scan, the app promoters use to scan tickets at the door. You'll work across five product teams. Each team writes and runs its own tests. You'll help them do it well, keep the automated test suites healthy, and test the riskiest releases yourself.

Some of what we ship carries real risk: payments, checkout, and getting people into venues on the night. Other changes are a line of copy. You'll help us tell the two apart and test each one accordingly. We use AI tools across development, and you'll help the teams use them to write better tests, faster.

Key responsibilities 

- Keep the web end-to-end test suite healthy: fix flaky tests, add coverage for new features, and make sure a failing suite gets fixed quickly
- Grow automated testing for our iOS and Android apps and RA Scan with the app developers, so mobile tests run on every change
- Test high-risk releases yourself, such as payments and checkout, including edge cases and what happens when things fail
- Review the test plans teams write, and help them improve
- Use AI tools to write and maintain tests, help developers do the same, and check what the tools produce
- Brief our external testing partner and review the results they send back
- Report bugs clearly, and follow them through with developers and product managers
- Track a few simple measures, such as bugs that reach production and how reliable the automated tests are

We’re looking for 

- Several years in QA or test engineering, typically four or more, testing web and mobile products
- Hands-on test automation: you've built and maintained automated tests that run in CI, for web (for example Playwright, Cypress or Selenium) and ideally mobile. We use XCUITest on iOS and Espresso with Kotlin on Android
- Enough coding to write and fix tests alongside developers, in a language such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Kotlin or Swift
- You can test APIs and check data with SQL
- Good judgement about risk: what to test deeply, what lightly, and what not at all
- You've used AI tools in your testing work, and know where they help and where they don't
- Clear writing: bug reports and test plans other people can act on
If you meet most of these but not all, we'd still like to hear from you. Nobody arrives with all of it, and we'll help you grow into the rest.

Nice to have 

- CircleCI or a similar CI tool
- Working with an external testing partner
- Payments, checkout or ticketing systems
- Testing apps used at live events, with poor networks
- Test management tools such as Qase or TestRail

What we offer you 

- Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
- Matched pension, or 401k for US staff.
- Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
- Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on merch.
- Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
- A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity ).
- Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community ).

More about RA 

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values 

- Electronic music is art.
- We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
- We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
- We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
- We use innovation to empower the community.
- We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
- We're always front left.

Listing details 

This role is a full-time, permanent position, based in Berlin. Please note: this position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary range for this role is €60,000 to €72,000. If you have questions about the role, please contact Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Interim Senior BI Analyst (All Genders)
description:
Across Europe, fleets are under enormous pressure. Fuel costs are rising. Regulatory requirements are tightening. The shift to low-emission vehicles is accelerating. And yet around 70% of European businesses still manage their fleets manually, with spreadsheets, disconnected tools, and processes that were never built for this moment. Shiftmove exists to make this simple.

We are a profitable B2B SaaS company and the fastest-growing fleet management platform in Europe, born from the merger of Avrios and Vimcar, and now serving tens of thousands of corporate customers across Germany, France, Spain, Switzerland, Poland, and beyond. Most recently, we acquired Optimum and Ocean in France, expanding our footprint and doubling down on one of Europe's largest fleet markets. Our AI-powered platform connects real-time vehicle data with intelligent software so that businesses can procure smarter, control costs, stay compliant, and lead the transition to cleaner mobility, all from one place.

About the role: 

We are looking for an experienced Interim Senior BI Analyst to join us on an initial three-month contract, with the option to extend for a further three months.

As we integrate two acquired French businesses into our group, we need to bring their data into our standard reporting while transforming how our executive team accesses and uses business intelligence. Our existing Tableau dashboards have evolved over time, and we see an opportunity to make them clearer, more consistent and more actionable.

Reporting to our VP of Operations, Data & BI , you will work closely with the executive team, Head of FP&A, RevOps and Data Engineering. You will take ownership of rebuilding our executive reporting, responding to daily analytical requests and ensuring that acquired-company data is accurately reflected in group-wide reporting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical BI skills with commercial acumen, sound analytical judgement and the confidence to challenge senior stakeholders when the data tells a different story.

What You'll Do

- Rebuild executive reporting: Audit our existing Tableau dashboards and the underlying business logic. Decide which dashboards to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire, and rebuild the priority dashboards so executives can quickly understand performance and make informed decisions
- Establish consistent metrics: Document and align metric definitions to ensure that business performance is measured consistently across dashboards, teams and entities
- Own daily ad hoc reporting: Manage requests through our Jira-based data support queue, prioritising, scoping and delivering analyses on a daily basis. Translate ambiguous requests into clear business questions and identify recurring needs that can be addressed through standard reporting
- Integrate acquisition data: Partner with Data Engineering as acquired-company data is migrated into Snowflake. Validate and reconcile data against source systems, build and maintain dbt models, and incorporate the data into existing Tableau dashboards so group reporting reflects all entities
- Deliver commercial insights: Translate executive requirements into meaningful analysis of go-to-market performance, including pipeline, bookings, ARR, retention and churn
- Partner with Finance: Work closely with the Head of FP&A to reconcile BI reporting with financial figures and establish a consistent view of business performance
- Present findings and challenge assumptions: Communicate insights directly to the executive team, explain what the data means for the business, and challenge assumptions where the evidence supports a different conclusion
- Enable a smooth handover: Document dashboards, data models, metric definitions and reporting processes so the permanent BI team can take ownership of the work at the end of the interim period

What You Need to Succeed

- You bring extensive experience in BI or analytics , including at least three years working at a senior level
- You have expert-level Tableau dashboard development skills, including experience redesigning dashboards for executive audiences
- You have strong SQL skills and hands-on experience working with Snowflake
- You have practical experience with dbt, including building and maintaining data models, tests and documentation
- You understand go-to-market performance and are fluent in metrics such as pipeline, bookings, ARR, net and gross retention, and churn
- You have a track record of translating executive requirements into analysis that informs business decisions
- You have experience integrating acquired, migrated or otherwise disparate data sources into existing reporting environments
- You are comfortable managing a Jira ticket queue and delivering reporting requests within daily turnaround expectations
- You communicate exceptionally well in written and spoken English and are confident presenting to C-level stakeholders, including challenging assumptions when the data warrants it
- You are based in Europe and available to work 35 hours per week for the duration of the contract

Nice to have: 

- French or German language skills
- Experience in a SaaS or subscription-based business
- Experience working with Salesforce, HubSpot or NetSuite data models
- Experience building a semantic layer or self-service analytics capabilities for executive stakeholders
- Experience reporting to private equity investors or preparing board-level reporting packs

What Success Looks Like

We want you to make a tangible impact from the start

- By Day 30: Complete an audit of existing dashboards and underlying business logic, with a clear recommendation to retain, consolidate, redesign or retire each dashboard. Take ownership of the Jira queue and establish a reliable daily delivery rhythm

About Kirby Group Engineering 
Kirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.

Role Purpose 
The Electrical QC Inspector ensures that electrical systems, components, and installations comply with safety and quality standards. The role includes conducting inspections, testing, and documenting results to verify that work meets project requirements, codes, and industry standards.

Key Functions: 

- Inspection of Electrical Installations: Inspect electrical systems and installations during and after the construction process to ensure compliance with safety regulations, project specifications, and industry standards (e.g., NEC, IEC).

- Quality Control Monitoring: Monitor and verify electrical works for quality control, ensuring all installations adhere to engineering drawings, plans, and specifications.

- Testing and Verification: Perform a variety of electrical tests (e.g., continuity tests, insulation resistance tests, voltage tests) to verify the functionality and safety of installed systems.

- Documentation: Maintain and complete detailed inspection records, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and testing logs. Provide feedback to supervisors and project managers regarding quality-related issues.

- Non-Conformance Handling: Identify and report non-conformance items, working with relevant personnel to resolve issues, ensuring corrective actions are implemented.

- Collaborate with Site Engineers: Work closely with engineers and contractors to resolve quality-related issues and ensure work is executed according to project specifications.

- Safety Compliance: Ensure all electrical work is performed safely, adhering to workplace safety standards and relevant electrical codes.

- Inspection of Materials: Inspect incoming electrical materials, ensuring that components meet specified standards and quality levels before being used in installations.

- Continuous Improvement: Provide feedback and suggestions for improvements in processes, materials, and quality control systems.

Necessary requirement of the Quality Control Inspector: 

- A strong Trade/Construction background and/or a third level qualification in Electrical/Mechanical Engineering.

- A minimum of 3 year’s experience in a lead/managerial position.

- Excellent communication and people skills with the ability to adapt.

- Ability to work on own initiative is essential as well as taking direction where required.

- Ability to work in conjunction with others and be a team player.

- Commitment to working to the highest possible standards and delivering high quality results.

- Proficient in the use of MS office, BIM 360 Field Management or similar platforms.

- Data Centre, Pharma or similar experience.

Desired competencies / special roles requirements 

- Experience in Electrical Testing & Commissioning

- CompEx Ex01-04 training

- Experience of working on HV/MV systems. ‘Authorised person’ experience

At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create.

We just unveiled JetBrains Central, a platform for agent-driven software development that connects tools, agents, and infrastructure. It enables automated AI workflows to run, be monitored, and be managed across teams – with clear visibility into results, costs, and performance.

JetBrains Central provides three core capabilities:
Governance and control: Policy enforcement, identity and access management, observability, auditability, and cost attribution for agent-driven work. Some of these functionalities are already available via the JetBrains Central Console .
Agent execution infrastructure: Cloud agent runtimes and computation provisioning that allow agents to run reliably across development environments.
Agent optimization and context: Shared semantic context across repositories and projects, enabling agents to access relevant knowledge, and task routing to the most appropriate models or tools.

Inside the Professional Services department, we are building a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help our customers adopt AI-native development with JetBrains Central and enable JetBrains consulting partners to transform their customers’ AI-native software development lifecycle.

About the role 

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with early adopter customers to deploy JetBrains Central platform into complex enterprise environments and help them move from experimental AI usage to governed, scalable AI-native development.

You will act as a trusted advisor to customer engineering teams and consulting partners, while also mentoring other Forward Deployed Engineers and helping with complex deployments. In this role, you will help establish best practices for enterprise AI adoption and influence how organizations implement AI-driven software development.

This role is often a strong fit for engineers who have previously served as Principal or Staff Engineers, Heads of Engineering, CTOs, or Solutions Architects and who enjoy working directly with customers while staying deeply involved with complex technical systems.

This role combines consulting, architecture, and hands-on engineering. Your work in the field will directly influence how our platform evolves and how enterprises adopt AI-driven development.

You will work directly with the world’s most innovative companies — our client base includes 420 of the Fortune 500 — ensuring they maximize the value of their JetBrains investments.

What you’ll do 

- Deploy JetBrains Central platform into enterprise development environments, CI/CD systems, and internal developer platforms.

- Implement enterprise AI governance, including security policies, access management, and data privacy controls.

- Enable observability for AI-driven development to help organizations understand their AI usage and its impact on productivity, as well as their code-generation patterns.

- A consultant at heart who can communicate effectively with both engineers and technical leadership.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next. 

We're hiring an IT Program Manager who will be at the centre of how Moss buys, manages and eventually retires technology. You'll own the vendor and contract landscape, steer the Tech Operations budget, and lead the company-wide platform migrations and consolidations that come a few times a year. 

You'll report to the CISO and work closely with our Tech Operations engineers and Information Security team, alongside Legal, People Ops and FP&A, across a technology estate spanning 350 people and five offices.

Your responsibilities 

- Own vendor and contract negotiations across Moss's SaaS, tooling, infrastructure and connectivity providers, running competitive evaluations to build commercial leverage and maintaining the renewal calendar and contract repository

- Plan and steer the Tech Operations budget, creating cost transparency per team and driving licence right-sizing, optimisation and consolidation across the tool estate

- Partner with teams across Moss to understand how tools are actually used, matching licence tiers to real usage and deciding which overlapping tools to keep based on what genuinely serves people, not just cost

- Drive down the number of tools Moss runs by finding shadow IT, bringing it into the process or consolidating it, and owning retirement work together with Information Security

- Lead company-wide technology migrations and retirements end to end, from business case and migration plan through cutover, communication and training

- Bring structure to how work reaches Tech Operations, building a clear intake process and owning the KPIs and monthly management reporting for the domain

- Work with Legal on contracts and DPAs and with People Ops on joiners and leavers, owning the commercial relationship and negotiation for the vendors in your portfolio within Moss's existing Vendor Management framework

About you 

- Several years of experience in IT vendor management, procurement, sourcing, tech operations or IT service management, ideally gained in a scaling company

- Proven experience negotiating with vendors and providers, including on service levels and cost

- Experience leading at least one company-wide tool migration or consolidation end to end, including decommissioning the old system

- A hands-on IT background, enough to keep essential services running from documented runbooks in an emergency

- AI is core to how we work. We expect someone with an "AI Driver" toolkit: measurable, real-workflow AI use with concrete before/after impact, ideally including built automations or agents (n8n, Claude skills, or similar).

- German at C1 or above, prior experience in a regulated environment (financial services, payments or e-money), exposure to ISO 27001, SOC 2 or DORA, or an ITIL/IAITAM qualification are all a plus

In addition, here are the skills and attributes we are looking for:

- A talent for moving things forward through clarity and good process rather than hierarchy

- Comfortable owning commercial outcomes inside a governance framework someone else owns

- Genuine curiosity about how other teams work, and translating that into better commercial calls than a dashboard would

- A structured, documentation-friendly way of working, with an instinct for turning manual work into something that runs itself

About Moss 

Moss is the Finance AI platform for Europe's mid-sized businesses, giving companies real-time visibility and full control over their spend. By automating card issuing, invoice management and expenses, Moss simplifies financial workflows and frees finance and accounting teams from manual, administrative work.

Founded in Berlin and used by more than 10,000 businesses including Flink, Schufa, n8n and Auto1, Moss has raised €220+ million to date and operates in Germany, the Netherlands, the UK and further EU markets. In August 2026, Moss closed a €35 million Series C led by Portage, crossing a €1 billion valuation and becoming one of Europe's newest fintech unicorns. Moss is backed by investors including Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Global Founders Capital, Cherry Ventures, A-Star.

We're a team of 300+ people from 50+ nationalities across 5 offices in Europe and we hire, reward, and grow people based on Moss DNA : playing to win, obsessing over quality, winning as One Moss. If that's how you want to work, we want to hear from you. - here's what else to expect:

title: Projektmanager Photovoltaik (m/w/d)
description:
Projektmanager Photovoltaik (m/w/d)

Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Um unsere ambitionierte Tech Roadmap umzusetzen haben wir im Frühjahr 2026 eine Seed-Finanzierung in Höhe von 10 Millionen Euro mit Set Ventures und AENU abgeschlossen. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Als Projektmanager Photovoltaik (m/w/d) verantwortest du die operative Steuerung unserer PV-Projekte von der Vertragsunterschrift bis zur fertigen Installation auf dem Dach. Du bringst unsere Kund:innen strukturiert, effizient und profitabel durch die gesamte Projektphase und koordinierst dabei eng mit unseren Lieferanten und Installationsbetrieben. Du arbeitest KPI-getrieben, greifst proaktiv ein und lässt kein Projekt liegen.

Deine Aufgaben 

- Du steuerst PV-Projekte aktiv von Unterschrift bis Abschluss mit dem Ziel, die Cycle Time konsequent zu reduzieren.

- Du koordinierst den direkten, operativen Draht zu PV-Modul-Herstellern, Großhändlern und Installationsbetrieben und sorgst für reibungslose Abstimmung bei Beschaffung, Terminierung und Durchführung.

- Du greifst proaktiv ein, sobald Zeit-KPIs überschritten werden oder Risiken für Durchlaufzeit, Profitabilität oder Kundenzufriedenheit entstehen.

- Du gewährleistest, dass Projekte vollständig, baubar und jederzeit korrekt im System abgebildet sind und kein Projekt verloren geht.

- Du behältst die Vollständigkeit der Projektunterlagen im Blick – erkennst frühzeitig, was fehlt, und sorgst dafür, dass es rechtzeitig vorliegt.

- Du hast die Profitabilität pro Projekt im Griff: Engpässe und Wartezeiten identifizierst du rechtzeitig, bevor sie auf das Ergebnis drücken.

- Du arbeitest eng mit dem Customer Support Team zusammen und übernimmst die proaktive, projektspezifische Kommunikation zu definierten Kontaktpunkten.

- Du schaffst transparente und aktuelle Projektstatus und gibst jederzeit Klarheit über Blocker und Handlungsbedarf.

- Du baust die Prozesse für PV-Projekte aktiv mit auf und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter, da es sie bei uns in dieser Form noch nicht gibt.

Dein Profil 

- Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung oder Studium in einem relevanten Bereich (z. B. Technik, Handwerk, Energie, Wirtschaft) oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung im Projekt- oder Operationsumfeld.

- Erfahrung im Projektmanagement, in Operations oder in einem technischen Umfeld (z. B. Bau, Handwerk, Energie).

- Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (C2).

- Sicherer Umgang mit CRM-Systemen und digitalen Tools.

- Erfahrung im Umfeld Photovoltaik, Wärmepumpe oder erneuerbare Energien ist ein Plus.

Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig: 

- Ownership – Wenn ein Projekt ins Stocken gerät, hast du das Problem längst erkannt – und bereits gehandelt. Du treibst Projekte intern konsequent voran, adressierst Abhängigkeiten klar und verbindlich gegenüber anderen Teams, und bleibst so lange dran bis das Ergebnis steht.

- Expert Operator – Du hast viele Projekte gleichzeitig im Blick – und weißt bei jedem, wo es steht, was als nächstes passieren muss und wo Gefahr droht. Prozesse und Prioritäten sind deine Werkzeuge, um auch bei hohem Volumen handlungsfähig zu bleiben.

- Data-Driven Optimizer – Cycle Time, Profitabilität, Terminierungen & Projektfortschritt – du schaust täglich auf deine KPIs, erkennst Muster bevor sie zum Problem werden und nutzt diese Erkenntnisse, um deinen Prozess kontinuierlich zu schärfen.

- Commercially Minded – Du weißt, dass Verzögerungen nicht nur Kunden frustrieren – sie fressen direkt in die Profitabilität. Du erkennst frühzeitig, wenn Wartezeiten oder Eskalationen auf das Ergebnis drücken, und steuerst aktiv dagegen.

- Proactive Problem Solver – Fehlende Unterlagen, blockierter Installationstermin, unerreichbarer Kunde – du lässt dich davon nicht aufhalten. Du findest einen Weg und sorgst dafür, dass das Projekt weiterläuft.

Benefits 

- Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups

- Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung

- Unser lebendiges Office ist das Herz unserer Kultur und fördert Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort

- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit anteiligem Homeoffice nach der Einarbeitung

- Individuelle Benefits, abgestimmt auf deine Bedürfnisse, z. B. Sportmitgliedschaften, ÖPNV-Ticket oder Learning Budget

description:

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Are you ready to join us?

About the Role 

As Data Engineer on our Healthcare Platform, you will own the foundational data ingestion, entity-resolution, and platform infrastructure end-to-end. You will design and operate scalable batch/streaming data pipelines, harden platform orchestration, and ensure system reliability, security, and cost efficiency.

A central challenge of this role is building and operationalizing our unified healthcare data ontology —a consistent semantic model covering hospitals, departments, specialties, metrics, and classification standards. Working closely with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and Methodology experts, you will turn heterogeneous, multi-country hospital data into a coherent, highly queryable data asset.

Key Responsibilities 

- Pipeline Infrastructure & Orchestration: Build, optimize, and operate reliable ELT pipelines (using Python, SQL, and Prefect/Airflow) to ingest data from heterogeneous international sources, APIs, databases, and lakehouse storage (S3, Apache Iceberg).

- Healthcare Ontology & Entity Resolution: Drive the implementation of entity resolution and master data management (MDM) for international hospital entities, mapping raw source data to canonical structures and maintaining standardized vocabularies (e.g., ICD/OPS, specialty taxonomies).

- Data Contracts & Schema Governance: Establish strict data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts) and schema management, ensuring dataset reproducibility, data lineage tracking, and automated validation across all platform pipelines.

- Platform Efficiency & Cloud Infrastructure: Optimize data storage, query execution, and compute costs across AWS and Snowflake, keeping data assets performant, secure, and cost-effective.

- Automation & CI/CD: Implement automated testing and deployment workflows for data pipelines using GitHub Actions and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).

- Cross-Functional Data Enablement: Partner directly with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and domain experts to deliver documented, research-grade, and production-ready datasets.

Qualifications 

Core Requirements (Must-Haves) 

- Data Ingestion & Pipeline Orchestration: Advanced Python and analytical SQL for complex data ingestion across diverse file formats, REST APIs, databases, and cloud lakes (S3/Iceberg). Hands-on experience with modern orchestrators (Prefect, Airflow, or Dagster).

- Entity Resolution & Data Governance: Practical experience with entity resolution/record linkage frameworks (e.g., Splink, dedupe, recordlinkage) and schema management/data contracts (Pydantic, dbt contracts, or JSON Schema).

- Cloud Platform & Warehouse Infrastructure: Deep hands-on experience in an AWS production environment (S3, ECS/EC2) combined with cloud data warehouses (Snowflake).

- Automated CI/CD & Workflow Automation: Proven track record of automating data pipeline deployments, integration tests, and validation workflows via GitHub Actions.

Nice-to-Haves (What Will Make You Stand Out) 

- Knowledge Graphs & Healthcare Terminologies: Exposure to ontology/semantic frameworks (RDF/OWL, SKOS, Neo4j, LinkML) or international medical classifications/vocabularies (SNOMED CT, ICD/OPS, FHIR).

- Metadata & Lineage Tooling: Experience operating metadata registries and lineage catalogs (e.g., OpenMetadata, DataHub, dbt docs).

- Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Proficiency in using Terraform to declaratively manage cloud resources and environments.

Your Profile 

- Degree: Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

- Experience: 3+ years in data engineering building production pipelines and data platforms; including a sustained period within one organization seeing a core platform or product through build → launch → iteration.

- Domain Knowledge: Healthcare domain experience is a plus (basic understanding of healthcare KPIs, quality metrics, or benchmarking concepts; familiarity with hospital structures and medical classification systems like ICD/OPS is especially valuable).

- Mindset: Strong analytical and systems mindset, with a proven ability to transform messy, heterogeneous international data into a clean, well-governed, and highly structured data asset.

- Languages: Fluent in English, German is a plus.

- Working Style: Highly structured, curious, detail-oriented, and motivated to collaborate closely with analytics engineers, data scientists, and methodology experts in an international environment.

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model . title: Director UX Design
description:
About HelloFresh 

HelloFresh Group reaches more than 6 million customers across 16 markets through a portfolio of 8 consumer brands — from meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to pet food and specialty products. HelloTech, our global technology division, builds the digital consumer experience across Berlin, Warsaw, and North America: the apps, the personalization, the discovery moments, and everything in between that turns food into something people genuinely look forward to.

Design is core to how we compete. Our Consumer UX team designs end-to-end experiences across all 8 brands, and we hold a high quality bar — internally, our “zest-appeal” framework defines design excellence from baseline usability through to best-in-class, surprise-and-delight craft. We are also moving fast to an AI-native way of working, where AI rethinks discovery, prototyping, and the path from design to code. Experience quality and innovation are leadership priorities all the way to the group president.

About the role 

This year we are doubling down on craft, execution, and design leadership. In a world where it is easier than ever to get software to 75% built, it is the last 25% — the polish, the motion, the detail customers actually feel — that decides whether a consumer experience is merely useful or genuinely loved. Millions of people open our apps every week to feed themselves and their families; the final 10% is the difference between a transaction and a habit.

This is a build-and-scale role, not a maintenance one. We are hiring a design leader to own a consumer experience domain within the Consumer mega alliance, raise the quality bar across it, grow a high-performing team, and build the design-technology and AI-native capability that turns ambitious ideas into beautifully executed, shipped products. We need a maker and a leader who leads through the work — not a strategy-only or people-management-only role.

The level — Director or Senior Director — will be set by the candidate’s experience and the final scope of the domain. We are open to both.

What You’ll Do: The Recipe 

- Lead from the front. Lead, coach, and inspire a multidisciplinary team — UX, UI, content, and localization — across multiple consumer surfaces. Stay hands-on in the work: review designs, jump into critiques, and drive clarity.

- Turn ambiguity into clarity. Solve problems from first principles, not templates. Help your team make hard decisions, focus on outcomes over process, and install just the right amount of structure and rigour to ship great work at speed.

- Set and uphold an extremely high craft bar. From UX flow to polished UI — layout, typography, motion, micro-interaction, and visual storytelling. Be the design-quality amplifier who notices the details others miss and pushes work to where it needs to be, coaching the team to our quality tenets.

- Own a consumer experience domain end-to-end. Take accountability for the quality and delivery of experiences across the customer journey, from problem framing to shipped product across our brands and 16 markets. Drive design excellence through every detail.

- Build design-technology capability. Champion and scale our design system (Zest) and modern UI foundations. Close the gap between design and engineering through prototyping, design-to-code workflows, and component quality — making design and engineering faster together.

- Make us AI-native. Treat AI as an active part of how design gets done — accelerating discovery, generating and validating prototypes, and shortening design-to-delivery. Define the quality bar AI-assisted workflows must meet, and help the company rewrite how consumer products get built in the AI era.

- Partner deeply with Product and Engineering. Align on priorities, make tradeoffs, unblock delivery, and move fast. Advocate clearly and persistently for the right experience, and raise the ambition of the partners around you.

What You’ll Bring: The Ingredients 

- Team leadership. A track record of leading and growing high-performing design teams in product-first, consumer (B2C) companies — hiring, coaching, and developing designers at all levels, from IC to managers.

- High agency. You thrive in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, push for the right solution rather than the convenient one, and lean in to make things happen without waiting for permission.

- A bias to ship. Demonstrated success driving teams to ship great software at scale, not just making decks about it — owning execution across a product line and a portfolio of features.

- Exceptional craft and product taste. Strong visual and interaction sensibility and a high personal bar for detail. You know what great looks like for a consumer audience, and you can help teams get there — across hierarchy, motion, and micro-interaction.

- Design-technologist mindset. Fluency at the design–engineering boundary: design systems, component architecture, prototyping in code or advanced tools, and a practical grasp of front-end constraints.

- AI-native practice. You already use AI across the design workflow — for insight synthesis, rapid prototyping, and design-to-code — and have a point of view on scaling it responsibly with a high quality bar. Fluency with tools like Figma, Claude, and similar is expected.

- Scale and systems thinking. Experience designing and maintaining quality across a multi-brand or multi-market consumer ecosystem, balancing consistency with brand-specific character.

What Success Looks Like 

- Your team consistently delivers high-quality consumer product work at speed.

- You have hired exceptional talent and helped your existing team grow in craft and execution maturity.

- Experience quality in your domain is visibly higher — the last 10% is sweated, and it shows in what customers feel.

- Product and engineering leaders love partnering with you because you unlock progress and raise the ambition.

- Design systems and AI-native workflows in your domain make the whole team faster without sacrificing craft.

- You are a key player in shaping how HelloFresh builds consumer product in the AI era — writing new playbooks, not following old ones.

What We Offer: The Toppings 

- Scale and impact. Shape experiences for 6+ million customers across 8 brands and 16 markets.

- A craft-and-AI-first culture. Leadership that champions experience quality, innovation, and AI-native ways of working from the top of the organization.

- Real ownership. End-to-end accountability for your domain, with the autonomy to set and raise the bar.

- Growth. A defined leadership track and the chance to expand scope as the alliance scales.

- Global collaboration. Work with experienced product, engineering, and design partners across HelloTech’s international teams.

Degree in Aerospace, Aeronautical, Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 

NICE TO HAVE 

- 
Direct knowledge and experience with OpenVSP and Flow5. 

- 
Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs, AI Agents, and modern MDO tools. 

- 
Experience in unmanned aerial systems (UAS) or rapid-prototyping defence environments.

description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

About the Team 

Minerva is STARK’s overarching Mission Operating System — the central cognitive backbone connecting all our unmanned platforms across air, land, and sea, while seamlessly integrating third-party systems and interfacing directly with national Battle Management Systems (BMS). Within this ecosystem, the Minerva Frontline organization owns the entire human-machine interface and operator experience on the ground. Our program brings together three specialized product pillars — Minerva Frontend Applications, Ground Control Stations (GCS), and Mission Simulation — distributed across Berlin and Munich. We operate with high autonomy, a mission-first mindset, and close collaboration between software engineers, hardware specialists, and operational experts to build reliable, intuitive systems that work when stakes are at their highest. 

Your Mission 

As Director Minerva Frontline , you are the holistic Program Owner and external face of STARK’s customer-facing software and mission control suite. Reporting directly to the VP of Software, you will lead the departments across Command & Control (C2) Applications, Ground Control Stations, and Simulation, unifying their efforts into one cohesive, battle-tested product experience. You will set the visionary product roadmap internally while representing our capabilities externally to military stakeholders, procurement agencies, and partners across NATO nations. 

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK 

- Own the end-to-end Minerva Frontline program , taking full accountability for its strategic roadmap, program budget, commercial targets, and cross-functional delivery across all three product lines. 

- Lead, mentor, and empower three direct reports and scale the broader multi-disciplinary organization across Berlin and Munich in these teams. 

- Define and communicate a compelling product vision internally, aligning engineering and UX teams around operator needs so that software, ground station hardware, and simulation environments feel like one seamless system. 

- Serve as the primary external representative for Minerva Frontline , pitching and demonstrating our C2, GCS, and simulation capabilities to military end-users, defence ministries, and procurement bodies (e.g., BAAINBw). 

- Drive seamless system interoperability , ensuring Minerva Frontline connects effortlessly with STARK’s physical unmanned platforms, third-party assets, and sovereign Battle Management Systems . 

- Translate complex battlefield and customer requirements into structured, actionable engineering priorities, balancing rapid prototyping with mission-critical reliability and safety. 

- Establish and scale a lean Program Management Office (PMO) over time to professionalize program tracking, release planning, and cross-entity alignment. 

- Collaborate closely with Commercial, Marketing, and Physical Platform Leads to shape go-to-market materials, pricing models, and integrated system demonstrations at test ranges and customer sites. 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION 

- Proven senior leadership and program ownership experience managing complex, multi-team software or cyber-physical product organizations, including responsibility for roadmaps, budgets, and delivery. 

- Strong technical background in building mission-critical software suites , ideally combining software engineering leadership with hardware-in-the-loop, robotics, C2 systems, or ground control interfaces. 

- Credibility and domain expertise in the defence or aerospace sector , with the ability to speak at eye level with military decision-makers, operators, and technical engineers alike. 

- Exceptional internal and external communication skills — you know how to inspire engineering teams with a crisp vision and persuasively represent complex technical products to B2G (Business-to-Government) customers. 

- High organizational rigor and an owner’s mindset , capable of turning startup ambiguity into clear structure and driving execution under high tempo. 

- Willingness to travel regularly between our hubs in Berlin and Munich as well as to customer sites, military bases, and test ranges across Europe. 

- Fluency in English (written and spoken) is mandatory. 

Nice-To-Have 

- Prior military service (e.g., former officer or reservist in the Bundeswehr or a NATO allied force), particularly within IT, Cyber, C2, or Air Defence domains. 

- Fluency in German , enabling seamless direct engagement with German defence stakeholders and procurement authorities. 

- An established network within the European defence ecosystem , military procurement agencies, or the NATO technology community. 

- Experience with tactical Battle Management Systems (BMS) , military simulation environments, or unmanned systems (UxV) operations.

title: Lead Solutions Architect - Generative AI (EMEA Emerging DNB)
description:
REQ ID: FEQ227R147 

Location: Germany (Remote/Hybrid) - will require travel across Europe 

Recruiter: Dina Hussain 

About the Role 

We are looking for a Lead Solution Architect focused on Generative AI to support our EMEA Emerging Digital Natives and Startups business unit — one of the fastest-moving, most technically ambitious patches in EMEA. Our customers are digital-native and cloud-native companies who build on the frontier: they adopt GenAI early, scale fast, and expect their technical partners to be as sharp as their own engineers.

You will be the go-to expert our Account Teams and customers turn to when a GenAI or LLM use case needs to move from an ambitious idea to a production-grade reality across our high-growth accounts.

This is a highly technical, customer-facing individual contributor role for someone who lives at the frontier of applied GenAI. You will shape architectures, prove out the hard problems, challenge and influence customer roadmaps, and raise the GenAI capability of the entire EMEA Emerging DNB field organisation.

What You'll Do 

- Serve as the deep technical authority on Generative AI, LLMs, and applied machine learning for the EMEA Emerging DNB business unit, supporting the most strategic and complex customer engagements across our digital-native and born-in-the-cloud accounts.

- Partner with our EMEA Emerging DNB Solutions Architects, Solutions Engineers, and Account teams to scope, design, and de-risk GenAI use cases — from retrieval-augmented generation and agentic systems to fine-tuning and evaluation.

- Build hands-on proofs of concept and reference implementations that operationalise large-scale LLM and deep learning workloads on Databricks (Mosaic AI, MLflow, Model Serving, Vector Search, Unity Catalog governance), tuned to the fast iteration cycles Emerging DNB customers expect.

- Lead fine-tuning and model-customisation engagements on open LLMs (e.g., Llama-family models), including judge-based and label-efficient evaluation approaches for domains where quality and safety are paramount.

- Act as a bridge to Product and Engineering — channel field and customer feedback into the roadmap and represent the roadmap back to the field.

- Enable and mentor the broader EMEA Emerging DNB Field Engineering team through workshops, reference architectures, and internal enablement, multiplying GenAI expertise across our ~70-person SA/SE organisation.

- Represent Databricks externally as a technical thought leader — conference talks (e.g., Data + AI Summit), blogs, and customer executive briefings.

What We're Looking For 

- Strong understanding of the LLM landscape, including leading proprietary and open-source models and providers, with the ability to differentiate their capabilities, trade-offs, and suitability for different use cases, and to articulate a clear, informed point of view (POV) to customers.

- Deep expertise in the modern GenAI stack: LLM application patterns (RAG, agents, tool use), fine-tuning and model customization, prompt and evaluation engineering, and LLM guardrails/safety.

- Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, including distributed training, GPU workloads, and the full MLOps lifecycle (tracking, registry, serving, monitoring).

- Proficiency in Python and the ML ecosystem (PyTorch/Transformers, MLflow, Spark), and comfort building production-quality reference implementations.

- Experience with the Databricks platform — or the ability to ramp on it quickly — including Mosaic AI, Model Serving, Vector Search, and Unity Catalog. Cloud experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP.

- Excellent communication and consultative skills: able to earn the trust of both hands-on engineers and senior technical executives, and to explain complex GenAI trade-offs clearly.

- A track record of technical leadership and mentorship — someone who elevates the people around them.

- Comfort operating at the pace of digital-native and high-growth customers, where speed, iteration, and technical credibility win the deal.

- Based in the United Kingdom and able to work across EMEA time zones, with willingness to travel to customer sites within the region as needed.

- Background helping digital-native customers build data and ML solutions (e.g., prior experience at a data/ML platform or consulting vendor) is a strong plus.

Nice to Have 

- Public technical presence: conference speaking, published talks, blogs, or open-source contributions in the ML/GenAI space.

- Domain depth in a regulated or high-stakes industry (healthcare/life sciences, financial services) where model quality, evaluation, and safety are critical.

- Experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmap.

Why This Role 

You will work on the hardest and most exciting GenAI problems our EMEA Emerging DNB customers have — companies building the future in real time — with the platform and the people to actually solve them, not just advise. You'll shape how one of EMEA's highest-growth business units adopts Generative AI, influence the direction of the product, and build a public profile as a recognised expert in the field. This is the role for a builder and a teacher, who wants their expertise to have outsized impact.

About Databricks 

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram .

title: Senior Partnership Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team 

You will join our B2C DACH Team, which manages our core markets in Germany and Austria. We are a collaborative group of commercial and growth professionals focused on delivering exceptional platform experiences, maintaining high customer trust, and driving sustainable, cost-effective customer acquisition. In this role, you will work closely with the Country Head DACH and collaborate across Product, Tech, Investment/Pension, and broader Marketing departments to scale our partner channel.
Your Responsibilities 

As our Senior Affiliate Manager DACH , you will take full ownership of driving performance-based customer growth through affiliate and strategic brand partnerships. You will act as both a strategic manager and a hands-on executor to acquire new partners and maximise the performance of existing relationships.

- End-to-End Partner & Campaign Management: Manage and scale our affiliate marketing programs in the DACH region to ensure consistent, sustainable growth within defined CPR (Cost per Registration) and CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost) targets.

- Proactive Partner Acquisition ("Hunting"): Continuously map, identify, and acquire high-converting new partners (financial comparison engines, specialised publishers, content creators, and influencers) and strategic brand-to-brand partnerships using direct outreach and industry networks.

- Key Account Growth ("Farming"): Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with top-tier DACH affiliate partners. Conduct regular site audits to ensure integrations, interest rates, landing pages, and promotional assets remain accurate and fully optimised.

- Cross-Functional & Product Line Expansion: Collaborate closely with specialised teams (such as Investment and Pension) to launch targeted affiliate initiatives that drive acquisition for specific high-growth financial products.

- Operational & Tracking Excellence: Ensure seamless tracking setup, precise campaign attribution, remuneration contract management, and efficient invoicing processes across our network partners (e.g., Impact, financeAds).

- Data-Driven Performance & Cost Control: Rigorously monitor channel performance, competitor activities, and market trends using Looker and HubSpot. Ensure cost efficiency and ROI superiority compared to other paid acquisition channels.

- Process Innovation & Internal Advocacy: Continually evaluate, test, and innovate our affiliate processes while serving as the primary subject matter expert and advocate for marketing partnerships across the company.

Your Profile 

Must-Haves 

- Relevant Experience: At least 5 years of professional experience in Affiliate Marketing, Partner Management, or performance marketing within the DACH region.

- Deep Domain & Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of tracking setups, attribution models, affiliate network mechanics (e.g., Impact, financeAds), commercial remuneration structures, and digital marketing trends.

- Commercial & Analytical Mindset: Proven track record of managing performance budgets, maintaining target acquisition costs (CPR/CAC), and utilising data analytics tools (e.g., Looker, Excel) to optimise campaign outcomes.

- Strong Interpersonal & Negotiation Skills: Excellent communication skills with a hands-on, proactive attitude and a strong commitment to team collaboration and problem-solving.

- Language Proficiency: Business fluency in both German and English (written and spoken) is required to manage partner relationships and engage effectively within our international team.

Nice-to-Haves 

- FinTech & Financial Product Interest: Prior experience or strong curiosity regarding personal finance, banking products, investments, or pension topics.

- Tool Familiarity: Practical experience working with CRM and affiliate software platforms such as HubSpot, Impact, or similar enterprise partner management suites.

- AI & Automation Curiosity: Experience leveraging Generative AI tools to streamline routine partner communication, market research, or operational workflows.

Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! 

At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.

As part of our team, you will benefit from:

- Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.

- Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.

title: Account Executive - Enterprise Grower (DACH Market)
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The DACH Enterprise team is at the forefront of driving revenue and growth across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. As trusted business partners, we work with the most ambitious market leaders and high-growth innovators — DeepL, Refurbed, N26 to Nestlé — helping them build the financial infrastructure that powers their next stage of growth. We're known for our product expertise, rigorous thinking, and user-first approach to problem-solving.

Stripe's financial infrastructure is the engine that unlocks new revenue streams, automates complex local compliance, and drives global expansion for the region's most prominent businesses. This is a pivotal moment for Stripe in DACH — the market opportunity is significant, and our team serves as a critical source of user feedback and market intelligence, with direct influence on the product roadmap and growth strategy. We're a diverse, international team that values collaboration and curiosity, and we're looking for someone who's eager to share knowledge and keep learning.

What you’ll do 

As an Account Executive, Enterprise Grower at Stripe, you’ll manage the growth, retention, and expansion of enterprise customer relationships, while identifying new opportunities to expand Stripe’s footprint within existing accounts. You’ll own a named portfolio of high profile accounts serving as the primary executive point of contact for senior stakeholders across business, product, and technology. You will be responsible for defining and executing multi-year account strategies, generating your own targeted outbound opportunities, and orchestrating complex, multi-threaded sales cycles—from discovery and solution design through commercial negotiation, onboarding of new products, activation, and expansion. You are an energetic and highly organized self-starter who understands how to navigate complex organizations, engage the right decision-makers and influencers, and succinctly communicate Stripe’s differentiated value—both business and technical—for each customer.

Responsibilities 

- Own a named account list and develop account plans for winning new business with digital native and enterprise companies

- Build, prioritize, and manage a robust, multi-threaded enterprise sales pipeline, including multi-quarter forecasting and account planning.

- Own the full sales cycle end to end—from executive engagement and lead generation through scoping, solution design, commercial negotiation, closing, onboarding, activation, and early expansion.

- Proactively generate your own pipeline through targeted outreach (e.g. cold calling, blitzing, research, networking, events, partners) and by driving a clear territory and account strategy.

- Effectively manage and advance leads qualified by inbound and outbound sales development representatives, ensuring smooth hand-offs and high conversion into late-stage opportunities.

- Ensure every potential and existing Stripe user has an excellent, high-touch experience at every interaction, regardless of deal size, seniority, or stage of the relationship.

- Identify and deeply understand users’ business models, technical environments, and pain points in order to shape and propose impactful Stripe solutions and multi-year roadmaps.

- Orchestrate and coordinate cross-functional Stripe teams (e.g. Solutions Engineering, Product, Legal, Risk, Operations, Marketing, Partnerships, Leadership) to align on strategy and ensure internal resources are set up for user success and long-term growth.

Minimum requirements

- 6+ years of sales experience, preferably selling a highly technical product to enterprise customers, with a track record of top performance 

- Ability to understand technical requirements and craft solutions across multiple products

- Ability to develop and execute account plans spanning multiple business units across complex organizations

- A knack for working well with a wide range of people, both internally and externally

- Strong presentation skills, particularly for in-person meetings with multiple stakeholders

- Proven ability to lead complex negotiations involving bespoke commercial agreements

- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and in German

- Ability to operate in a highly ambiguous and fast-paced environment • Strong interest in technology and a deep understanding of the space

Preferred requirements 

- Strong interest and knowledge in technology, the payments landscape, and related products, with the ability to advise customers strategically on payments, monetization, and platform architecture.

- Superior verbal and written communication skills, including experience crafting and delivering executive presentations, proposals, and commercial narratives.

- Ability to think and operate strategically (e.g. building multi-year account plans, portfolio strategies) and connect this thinking back into concrete operational execution across internal teams and customer stakeholders.

title: Senior Security GRC Engineer
description:
Why Mozilla? 

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we're shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we're doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren't beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role: 

This role is part of the Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) function within Mozilla's Security team. The Security team supports Product, Enterprise, and GRC functions across the organization, aligned with the mission to build a safe and secure internet. This role is responsible for maintaining and advancing Mozilla's Information Security Management System (ISMS) and supporting our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 compliance programs — from policy and control design through audit readiness and certification.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience across the full breadth of a compliance program, is comfortable building process where none yet exists, and works well with a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders.

What you'll do: 

- Maintain and mature the ISMS, including the Statement of Applicability (SoA), risk treatment plans, and the Management Review Meeting (MRM) process and cadence.

- Support ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type 2 audit execution—helping determine scope, preparing evidence and narrative artifacts, participating in auditor interviews and walkthroughs, and resolving auditor findings.

- Contribute to the SOC 2 System Description and other audit-specific narrative documentation, ensuring they accurately reflect the organization's actual control environment.

- Track gaps and remediation efforts arising from readiness assessments and audits.

- Lead the policy program—driving policy creation, revision, and cross-functional review cycles to keep the security policy set current, enforceable, and audit-ready.

- Support compliance scaling as additional products or business units pursue readiness assessments and certification.

- Support the internal audit function, partnering with internal or third-party resources as needed to meet ISO 27001's internal audit requirements.

- Partner closely with Engineering, IT, Legal, Privacy, People teams, and product leadership to gather evidence, drive control ownership, and translate compliance requirements into practical, adoptable practices.

- Advise the GRC manager and broader Security leadership on audit risk, certification readiness, and compliance program strategy.

What you'll bring: 

- 5 years of experience in information security, GRC, or compliance-focused roles.

- Deep familiarity with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, gained through meaningful involvement in audits from readiness through certification.

- Comfort operating across the full breadth of an ISMS—SoA maintenance, Management Review Meetings, and System Description authorship.

- Demonstrated experience writing and revising security policies, including running cross-functional review cycles to gain organization-wide buy-in and adoption.

- Experience tracking gaps and remediation plans and connecting that work to an organization's broader compliance and risk program.

- Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills—comfortable working with engineers, product managers, legal, and executive stakeholders, and able to translate compliance requirements into practical, actionable workflows.

- Ability to ramp up quickly and operate with a high degree of independence.

- Comfort building processes where none yet exist.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to represent Mozilla credibly and confidently in front of external auditors.

- Relevant industry certifications (e.g., CISA, CISSP, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer) are a plus.

Commitment to our values: 

- Welcoming differences

- Being relationship-minded

- Practicing responsible participation

- Having grit

What you'll get: 

- Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees—we share in our success as one team.

- Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage.

- Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute).

- Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together.

- Country-specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday.

- One-time home office stipend.

- Annual professional development budget.

- Quarterly well-being stipend.

- Considerable paid parental leave.

- Employee referral bonus program.

- Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc.—varies by country).

About Mozilla 

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging 

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientation s, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

title: Senior Category Manager (Commercial)
description:
As a Senior Category Manager (Commercial) (m/w/d), you will own the global commercial success of PERGOLUX's tailormade pergolas, one of our biggest untapped growth opportunities. While roughly 70% of the market demands custom sizing, tailormade currently represents only a small share of our revenue, and your mandate is to change that by driving revenue, contribution margin, and market adoption across all PERGOLUX markets globally. Sitting at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Sales, and E-commerce, you will translate product potential into measurable business results and uncover the product adjustments needed to scale the category.

PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. With around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, we combine premium product quality with the pace and ownership culture of a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond.

What You'll Do 

- Own the global commercial performance of tailormade pergolas, including revenue, conversion, and contribution margin, and define the go-to-market and scaling strategy in alignment with Product Management and Country Managers.

- Identify and remove commercial bottlenecks across the funnel (traffic, conversion, average order value, attach rate) and continuously optimise based on data and insights across markets.

- Ensure optimal product presentation, pricing logic, content, and UX on all Shopify websites, and maintain consistent positioning and branding across every touchpoint.

- Pilot and scale new commercial initiatives such as bundles, promotions, upsell logic, and channel experiments, and enable local sales teams with playbooks, training, objection handling, and pricing logic.

- Generate industry and user insights that inform product development, and, when it keeps execution speed high, personally deliver first versions of website updates, ad copy, and sales scripts.

What You'll Bring 

- 4+ years of experience in E-commerce, Growth, Business Development, or Commercial Category Management, with a proven track record of driving revenue and margin growth in a complex or global environment.

- Fluent German language skills (required).

- Strong commercial intuition and an analytical mindset, comfortable working with funnel analytics (traffic, conversion rate, AOV, attach rate, contribution margin) and turning data into action.

- High ownership mentality, a clear bias for action, and a hands-on, zero-to-one execution style, paired with strong stakeholder management across global, cross-functional teams.

- Nice to have: experience with Shopify UX/content optimisation, GTM playbook creation, and product marketing, plus direct experience in home & garden, outdoor living, DTC furniture/hardware, or custom/tailormade product categories.

title: Product Manager, Homepage
description:

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing 

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

- Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.

- Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.

- Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.

- Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

- Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
