- You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.

- You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.

- You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).

- You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion 

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
Company Overview 

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas. These include airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special air missions, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. We own the whole stack: designing, building, and operating turnkey capabilities that give our partners decisive, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats.

Our operating model is built around three interlocking pillars. The Support Groups provide a global shared-service – spanning people, finance, platform, operations, legal, and engagement. This frees up our Core Groups, who develop and own mission capabilities end-to-end, to focus entirely on delivery. The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

At the heart of our model is a simple but powerful idea: be a true partner with skin in the game. Our partners need effects, not just equipment. By owning the full stack – from the lab to the field – we are able to drive a continuous cycle of innovation that keeps our partners ahead. It's a fast-moving, intellectually demanding environment where talented people are given real responsibility, work on problems that matter, and contribute to an enterprise that is growing quickly and deliberately.

Headquartered in Washington, DC, with facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, as well as Continental Europe and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview: 

Metrea Management  is our global shared service providing support for the Capabilities in areas such as People, Finance, Legal, Strategy, Safety, Security and Information Technology.   

Metrea delivers effects-as-a-service to national security partners across five domains and more than a dozen mission areas—including airborne ISR, electronic warfare, secure communications, aerial refueling, special mission aviation, aerial firefighting, and advanced simulation. Whenever we operate, we build vertically integrated full stacks of capability—designing, building, and operating turnkey solutions that let customers scale capacity while benefiting from continuous cycles of innovation. With operators and engineers under one roof, we close the gap between lab and field—what we call connecting design with effect. Metrea’s solutions are built for elegance: effective, efficient, and evolving. This approach enables our partners to do more with less and achieve outsized, asymmetric advantage against rapidly evolving threats. Headquartered in Washington, DC, Metrea has facilities across the United States, the United Kingdom, Europe, and beyond. 

Position Summary  

At Metrea, we seek out the most complex national security challenges and proactively develop elegant solutions. Those solutions start with our people, and their ability to deliver mission-critical effects around the world.

Our Talent Acquisition team is focused on delivering equally compelling and strategic recruiting solutions to our teammates and business leaders through deep recruiting expertise, a consultative approach, and analytical rigour. In this role, you will partner closely with leaders across Metrea's European Support Groups to deliver high-quality hiring that enables the business to scale. You'll manage a broad portfolio of roles ranging from senior, high-touch searches to operational and specialist hiring, whilst leading a small team.

We're actively investing in our TA function and you'll own meaningful pieces of that build alongside your peers across Support. You will be successful if you are an experienced in-house recruiter who runs searches with sound judgement, knows what exceptional recruiting looks like, and can confidently influence senior stakeholders with clear recommendations and thoughtful challenge. Equally important: you're someone who wants to contribute to how we recruit at Metrea, lead and develop talent, and take ownership of projects that shape the way we work.

Role and Responsibilities 

- Lead end-to-end recruitment across Metrea's European Support Groups, managing a mix of operational, specialist, and leadership searches

- Lead and develop your team member, creating the conditions for good work, providing clarity on expectations, and supporting their growth and capability development

- Partner with hiring managers and senior stakeholders to shape talent strategies that align with business priorities, managing up effectively and educating on recruiting best practices

- Tenaciously source and build pipelines, whilst engaging and nurturing relationships with candidates using empathy and transparency, ensuring they're aligned with Metrea's mission and values

- Guide and consult with stakeholders using market knowledge and insights to ensure the best hiring decisions

- Own meaningful build projects within the European Support Groups function: developing recruiting frameworks and tooling, building team capability, and using data to influence hiring decisions and talent strategy.

- Manage multi-step hiring processes across European teams and time zones, ensuring a smooth and high-quality candidate experience

- Champion Metrea's employer brand across Europe to attract mission-aligned talent, bringing clarity and energy to who we are and why people should join us

- Collaborate across the TA function to develop and refine our recruiting practices, bringing your perspective and learning from peers working across other parts of the business

Skills and Experience 

- In-house recruitment experience in a scaling or fast-changing organisation, managing a broad range of roles at varying levels

- Proven people leadership experience. You've managed people before and know how to build trust, set clear expectations, and create space for others to grow

- Track record of knowing what excellence looks like in recruiting and being willing to hold the line on quality and approach

- Proven ability to consult, partner, and influence at multiple levels—managing up to leadership, laterally with peers, and as a leader to your team

- Strong familiarity with European talent markets, key talent pools, and industry trends across the region

- Strong judgement in shaping recruitment approaches and improving processes to deliver high-quality hires

- Track record of building and maintaining diverse, high-quality candidate pipelines at scale

- Experience managing multi-step, complex hiring processes across geographically dispersed teams and time zones

- Ability to balance breadth and depth, adapting to varying role types and business needs

- Experience with Greenhouse or other applicant tracking systems

- Familiarity with enterprise support functions including People, Finance, Operations, Legal, and Strategy

- Ownership mentality. You see problems and want to solve them, and you're energised by having clear ownership of meaningful work

Benefits 

- Private Medical Insurance    

- Subsided gym membership / plans through Wellhub    

- Electric Car scheme    

- Cycle to work scheme    

- Salary sacrificed pension scheme    

- Free lunch on office days   

- Enhanced Parental Leave   

- 30 days annual PTO plus b/h 

Right to Work 

The employee will have the legal right to work in the  UK  and will be able to produce  right  to work documentation.    

Equal Opportunities Statement 

Metrea Management Limited (MAM) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or other characteristics protected by law.  

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work 

This is a full-time non-exempt position with typical working hours of Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Hours and work shifts may change  in accordance with  department and business needs. Exempt Employees must have the ability to be on-call and available, as business needs require. Non-Exempt employees may  be required  to work over 40 hours per week with approval from the department manager.   

Work Location 

You will normally be required to work at/ from the Metrea Management Limited offices on The Third Floor, The Aircraft Factory, 100 Cambridge Grove, London, England , W6 0LE 

Work Environment 

This job operates in an office setting. Hybrid; minimum of 3 days/ week onsite 

Travel 

10% 

Our Firmware 

At Metrea, our single core value is Rooted in Humility, and our four cornerstone attributes are Entrepreneurial, Systematic, Discerning, and Over-Deliver. These form what we call our Teammate Firmware. Just like technical firmware connects software and hardware, our Firmware is the constant interface between our mission and our people. It defines how we show up, how we work together, and how we solve complex problems.

Our team Firmware creates a web-like, hyper-collaborative, dynamically hierarchical way of working that helps us adapt quickly, communicate openly, and distribute decision-making to where expertise actually lives. It enables groups to self-organize around hard problems, shift fluidly as priorities evolve, and operate with the trust, curiosity, and discipline required in a complex mission space. This foundation allows us to deliver elegant, effective solutions and uphold our purpose: protecting our precious inheritance.

description:

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute.  

It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.  

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Job Summary 

Join our dynamic Software Infrastructure team and take a pivotal role in scaling and managing our infrastructure. You will develop essential tools and services that empower our broader software team. Your contributions will enhance the build, test, deployment, and productisation processes of our Machine Learning Software components. Work with our High-Performance Computing (HPC) AI platforms and gain invaluable experience in distributed systems.

The Build Engineering team is a new function within Software Infrastructure, which focuses on the overall process of building and integration of the Machine Learn ing S oftware S tack. - Developing our internal tooling for building, testing and integrating together the ML Software Stack 

- Developing tools and technical processes for Software Releases 

- Providing guidance to developers on best build practices and dependency management 

- Communicating regularly with developers, tech leads, and software architects about aspects of the ML Software Stack 

- Working closely with QA and the ML Software Stack to resolve any integration issues 

- Contributing fixes towards the ML Software Stack 

Essential: 

- Knowledge of Python/C++ (or similar language) 

- Understanding of Build Processes and Frameworks 

- Experience working in Linux environments 

- Good communication skills 

Desirable: 

- Experience with Remote Caching and Execution (e.g. Bazel) 

- Experience with Build Tools (e.g. CMake) 

- Experience with Testing Frameworks (e.g. PyTest, GoogleTest) 

- Experience with Integration Tools (e.g. Buildstream) 

- Experience working within the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) 

- Experience with building and using containers (e.g. Docker, Podman) 

- An understanding of Software Architecture patterns

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

description:
About Fractile 

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

description:
Job title: Applied ML Technical Lead, Defence

Location: London; full in-office working as default

Start date: ASAP

Reports to: CEO

Compensation: Salary and Equity options available for discussion

Clearance: Must be eligible to hold UK Security Vetting Clearance SC or above (no prior clearance required)

Application Deadline: 08/11/26 at 23:59 UK Time 

___________________________________________________________________________

Help put frontier AI to work in Defence 

Cosine is a UK AI lab building models, applications and training infrastructure for mission-critical organisations.

We build coding agents that work across real software systems, specialised Lumen models, AI-native security products and the infrastructure needed to deploy advanced AI in demanding environments. Our customers include some of the world's largest enterprises, including organisations operating behind strict security, regulatory and technical constraints.

We're also training Lumen Sovereign, the first frontier large language model trained in the UK, with the support of the UK Government.

We're now looking for an Applied ML Technical Lead to help develop and deploy advanced AI capabilities for organisations operating in UK Defence and national security.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will work across machine learning development, deployment and customer-facing technical delivery. You may spend part of your time training and evaluating models on complex sensor data, and part of your time working with Defence stakeholders to understand operational needs, shape priorities and guide delivery.

You will not be expected to act as a traditional project manager. Instead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML work, coordinating the people and decisions needed to turn promising research into useful operational capability.

___________________________________________________________________________

What you'll do 

- Build ML capabilities for real Defence problems

- Design, build, train and evaluate machine learning models for challenging applied Defence and national security use cases.

- Work on problems involving complex sensor data, signal processing, pattern recognition, classification and multimodal intelligence.

- Develop and improve model architectures, training pipelines, evaluation frameworks and inference systems.

- Work with real-world and synthetic datasets to improve model accuracy, robustness and generalisation.

- Translate research prototypes into reliable, deployable capabilities that operate within demanding technical and security constraints.

- Work closely with Cosine's ML research and engineering teams while taking direct ownership of technical outcomes.

Lead technical delivery from prototype to deployment 

- Own the technical direction and day-to-day progress of applied ML projects.

- Turn operational objectives into concrete technical goals, experiments, milestones and success measures.

- Coordinate work across ML researchers, software engineers, infrastructure teams and external stakeholders.

- Identify technical dependencies, delivery risks and blockers, and help drive them to resolution.

- Establish clear evaluation criteria and demonstrate progress through measurable improvements and working capabilities.

- Balance hands-on engineering with the planning and coordination needed to keep complex technical work moving.

Work directly with Defence customers 

- Engage with technical and operational stakeholders across the UK Defence and national security ecosystem.

- Understand operational challenges and identify where machine learning can make a meaningful difference.

- Translate customer requirements and constraints into technical objectives, datasets, experiments and delivery plans.

- Present technical progress, demonstrate working capabilities and communicate results clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

- Build trusted relationships with Defence stakeholders and act as a credible technical counterpart.

- Help customers understand the practical considerations of integrating and deploying ML systems in their existing environments.

Turn research into operational capability 

- Help deploy ML models into real-world environments, including secure, on-premise and resource-constrained systems.

- Work on model optimisation, inference performance, integration and reliability.

- Develop robust approaches to evaluation, validation and continuous model improvement.

- Understand data availability, access requirements, security restrictions and deployment constraints.

- Establish feedback loops between operational users and Cosine's engineering teams.

- Ensure that what we build is not only technically impressive, but genuinely useful to the people relying on it.

___________________________________________________________________________

What we’re looking for 

You'll probably have a background in applied machine learning, ML engineering, research engineering or a similarly technical role, along with experience taking ownership of complex technical work.

You should be comfortable:

- Writing production-quality Python and working with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch.

- Building, training, fine-tuning and evaluating machine learning models.

- Working with complex datasets, designing experiments and interpreting model performance.

- Understanding the trade-offs between model performance, compute requirements, latency and deployment constraints.

- Working with engineering infrastructure, including Git, containers, Linux and GPU compute.

- Taking technical ownership of projects with multiple stakeholders, uncertain requirements and evolving priorities.

- Communicating technical concepts clearly to researchers, engineers, senior stakeholders and operational users.

- Moving between model development, customer discussions and delivery planning without losing technical depth.

- Making sound technical judgements, prioritising effectively and finding practical solutions when the path forward is unclear.

- You don't need to have worked in Defence before. You do need to be excited by the opportunity to apply advanced ML to difficult, consequential real-world problems.

Nice to have 

- Existing UK security clearance, such as SC or DV, or previous experience working in secure Defence environments.

- Experience with signal processing, time-series data, sensor fusion, representation learning or machine learning applied to complex real-world datasets.

- Experience with foundation models, multimodal learning or advanced model training and post-training techniques.

- Experience deploying ML models to edge devices or constrained compute environments.

- Familiarity with UK Defence procurement, technical assurance or the national security landscape.

- Experience leading technical workstreams or working as a technical lead on customer-facing ML projects.

___________________________________________________________________________

What success looks like 

In your first three months, we would expect you to:

- Become the technical lead for a major applied Defence ML programme, with responsibility for its day-to-day technical progress.

- Build strong working relationships with Cosine's ML researchers, engineers and key Defence customer stakeholders.

- Develop a clear understanding of the existing models, datasets, technical architecture and operational objectives.

- Establish a focused delivery plan with clear priorities, milestones, ownership and success measures.

- Make meaningful hands-on contributions to model development, evaluation or deployment.

- Identify and begin addressing the most important technical and operational blockers.

- Demonstrate tangible progress to customer stakeholders and build confidence in Cosine's ability to deliver.

- Longer term, you'll help take advanced ML capabilities from promising prototypes into operational use, while shaping how Cosine builds and delivers applied AI for Defence and other mission-critical organisations.

___________________________________________________________________________

Why this role matters 

Some of the most important applications of AI won't be found in consumer products. They'll be in environments where information is incomplete, systems are complex, security matters and the consequences of getting things wrong are significant.

Cosine is working to bring frontier machine learning into those environments.

Doing that requires more than good models. It requires people who can understand an operational problem, build something that works, make good technical decisions, coordinate the work needed to deliver it and stay close to the customer until it creates real value.

You'll have unusual proximity to cutting-edge ML research, senior Defence stakeholders and the operational challenges that will shape the next generation of AI capabilities.

This role will suit someone who is technically strong enough to build, organised enough to lead technical delivery and curious enough to engage directly with the people using the technology.

If you enjoy being close to the research, close to customers and personally accountable for turning ambitious technology into something real, come and work with us.

Come help make frontier AI useful where it matters most. 

___________________________________________________________________________

Cosine is an equal opportunity employer. 

We value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and ways of thinking, and we’re committed to creating an inclusive and respectful workplace.

We encourage applications from anyone who meets the role requirements, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the hiring process, we’re happy to discuss them.

Compensation, Benefits & Ways of Working 

We’re an in-office team, five days a week, by design. We believe the work we’re doing benefits from being together, collaborating closely, and building shared context.

What you can expect: 

- Competitive salary , benchmarked to the market

- Equity / share options , so you share in the upside you help create

- Work hard in the office, collaborate closely, and switch off properly 

- Dog-friendly office — bring your dog to work

- High-quality equipment to do your best work

We care about focus, sustainability, and doing great work — not performative overwork. We value people who show up, contribute thoughtfully, collaborate well with their colleagues, and then go home.

This role won’t suit everyone. But if you’re looking for a fast-moving environment, close collaboration, and a team that takes both the work and work-life balance seriously, it’s a great place to be.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
About the role 

Radiant exists to redefine how AI infrastructure is built and operated at scale. We are creating a vertically integrated AI platform that brings together physical infrastructure, control planes, and cloud-native software to deliver abundance, control, and sovereignty in a world constrained by traditional hyperscaler models.

Our vision is to enable organisations to build, train, and deploy AI at national and global scale without surrendering control over performance, cost, or locality. This requires engineering systems that operate across software, hardware, and physical environments, and that remain reliable as scale and complexity increase.

We are scaling our engineering organisation now. Most of our engineering manager seats are open. You join, shape how the teams work, and grow with them.

As an Engineering Manager, you lead a team building and operating core parts of Radiant's cloud platform. You combine people leadership, technical judgement, delivery ownership and cross-functional collaboration. You work closely with product, infrastructure, SRE, security and other engineering teams.

This is a hands-on leadership role. It focuses on building strong teams, delivering reliable platform capabilities, and creating an environment where engineers do their best work.

The streams 

We run engineering as ten streams in three groups. Each stream is a full team of about nine people: principal, senior and mid-level software engineers, an SDET, a DevOps engineer and a platform engineer. Each stream has its own engineering manager.

- Infrastructure: Compute, Network, Storage, Cluster

- Platform: Cloud, Infra, Observability, Security

- AI: Training, Inference

You do not apply for a single stream. We hire strong managers first. Then we agree your stream with you, based on your strengths and interests. Your first stream is a starting point, not a fixed track. Moves between streams are normal here.

Key responsibilities

title: Senior International Sales Recruiter, UK/EMEA
description:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

"At TRM, we believe the people we hire will determine how far and how fast we can go in our mission to build a safer world for billions of people. That’s why we’re building a Talent team that sees recruiting as a craft and a competitive advantage, people who challenge assumptions, move with urgency, and are energized by building exceptional teams to solve incredibly hard problems. If that sounds like you, we’d love to meet you."

– Alicia Strait , VP of Talent, TRM Labs

As TRM expands across EMEA and other global markets, our ability to hire the right sellers, compliance experts, and go-to-market talent in-region determines how fast our blockchain intelligence reaches the institutions and agencies fighting illicit finance worldwide. As an International Sales Recruiter , you'll own high-priority searches across EMEA and beyond — Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and broader business roles — partnering closely with hiring managers and Talent leadership to define strategy, map regional markets, engage passive candidates, and drive high-quality hiring decisions with speed and precision.

Your success is measured by the quality, velocity, and business impact of the hires you make across TRM's international business functions.

The impact you'll have: 

- Own full-cycle recruiting for international roles across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other functions.

- Act as a strategic talent partner to hiring managers, including advising on market dynamics, candidate calibration, sourcing strategy, and close approach.

- Build and execute targeted sourcing strategies that identify, engage, and close exceptional talent across EMEA and other global markets.

- Develop regional talent maps across priority markets that include high-performing companies, competitive talent, referral networks, and specialized candidate communities.

- Create an exceptional candidate experience where every touchpoint reflects TRM's talent bar, mission, and operating principles.

- Use data, market insight, and funnel conversion metrics to diagnose search health, influence hiring teams, and adjust strategy in real time.

- Drive urgency and decision quality through clear calibration, structured feedback, and timely hiring decisions.

- Continuously improve international recruiting including intake quality, scorecard alignment, sourcing strategy, debrief rigor, and offer execution.

- Partner cross-functionally with Talent, People, Finance, Legal, and business leaders to navigate international hiring considerations and keep searches moving.

What we're looking for: 

- 7+ years of recruiting experience, with strong experience supporting international sales hiring in high-growth technology companies.

- Proven success hiring across Sales, Post-Sales, Compliance, Marketing, and other business functions.

- Strong knowledge of EMEA talent markets, with the ability to adapt strategy by region, function, and candidate profile.

- Strong search fundamentals including market mapping, talent intelligence, passive candidate engagement, candidate assessment, and closing.

- The ability to quickly understand complex business roles across GTM, compliance, marketing, and operations.

- Strong analytical ability to interpret recruiting metrics, funnel health, conversion rates, and pipeline quality and translate them into action.

- Exceptional stakeholder management that includes building trust, influencing hiring managers, pushing back thoughtfully, and operating as a strategic advisor.

- Excellent written and verbal communication, including synthesizing market insight, candidate tradeoffs, and search progress clearly for stakeholders.

- High ownership, autonomy, persistence, and judgment in navigating ambiguous, specialized, business-critical searches.

- The ability to operate effectively in a remote, globally distributed environment with strong overlap across EMEA and U.S. business hours.

About the team: 

- Our talent team is fully remote and async-first. We keep work moving across time zones through Slack, thorough documentation, and proactive updates.

- We stay tightly aligned through weekly hiring syncs, team sourcing syncs, and bi-weekly team meetings where we solve challenges together.

- We care deeply about our craft: we continuously refine best practices and data quality to deliver an exceptional experience for candidates and internal stakeholders alike, backed by precise, reliable reporting.

- We're globally distributed but most of us overlap between 7am–12pm PST for real-time collaboration.

- Every team member, wherever they're based, maintains at least a 4-hour overlap with PST business hours.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position: 

- Within 72 hours of a role opening, you've scheduled the intake, researched and published the role, and brought 5 calibration profiles to the intake for the hiring manager to review.

- Within a week of opening the role, you've mapped the total addressable market, built a shortlist of the top 30 profiles, conducted 5–10 recruiter screens, and stood up the full interview process — including the approved questions that define what good looks like on a recruiter screen.

- Two weeks after the initial interviews, you analyze the data to identify what is and isn't driving pass rates and conversions, share insights and recommendations with the hiring team, and continue to monitor and adjust until the position is filled.

Our Onboarding Process: 

- Within your first 30 days , you’ll be fully onboarded, calibrated, and operating as the DRI for your positions.

- Within your first 60 days , you’ll have your first sourced candidates reaching final rounds.

- Within your first 90 days , you’ll have made 2–3 hires .

The following represents the estimated range of compensation for this role: 

- Individual pay is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. The compensation details listed in this posting reflect the US base salary only

- The estimated base salary range for this role is $153,000 - $172,000.

- Additionally, this role may be eligible to participate in TRM’s equity plan.

- Please note – we factor in the different costs for geographies outside the United States. 

Application Instructions 

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM 

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

- Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

- Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

- First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

- Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

- References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

- Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

- Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM 

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

- Accelerate repeatable workflows

- Structure and solve problems

- Improve output quality

- Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM 

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

- Priorities and targets to change quickly

- Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

- A high level of personal ownership and accountability

- Close collaboration across teams and functions

- Frequent, high-touch communication

- Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

- A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. 

Leadership Principles 

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

- Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

- Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

- Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission 

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operate

title: Strategic Account Manager (UK)
description:
Meet Siena 

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team 

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

You own the commercial relationship for Siena's highest-value brands: renewals, expansion, executive trust, and knowing your accounts better than anyone. A deployment strategist owns product outcomes for the same accounts, and together you're the Siena pod.

You're accountable for net dollar retention, expansion quota attainment, and executive relationship health across your book. You own our Growth and Strategic segment accounts, not the full customer book, working at the intersection of customer, sales, and your deployment strategist. Expect moderate travel for in-person workshops, account visits, and QBRs.

What You'll Do

- Own the commercial relationship end to end for a portfolio of Growth and Strategic accounts, from post-onboarding through long-term growth: build concrete account plans, track impact with data, and hold customers and internal teams accountable when progress stalls

- Map every account and build executive trust: maintain a living stakeholder map, build relationships with decision-makers beyond day-to-day contacts, and own the executive cadence so leadership sees Siena's value before renewal conversations start

- Drive commercial outcomes: own renewal negotiations, independently identify and close expansion opportunities, and quantify customer ROI in cost savings, efficiency, or revenue impact

- Bring product depth to the relationship: understand how Siena's agents work together, explain capabilities confidently, and guide customers on the best strategic use cases

- Lead cross-functional execution: turn vague customer problems into clear problem statements and execution plans, partnering with other teams as needed

Who You Are

The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you. 

- 3+ years in account management with technical, complex software, including at least one independently negotiated $100k+ deal

- Startup background: comfortable in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, wearing many hats

- E-commerce or CX industry experience: customers respond better to AMs who speak their language

- Your customers and your pod are US-based: this role requires overlap with the East Coast

Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one. 

- Hands-on AI experience: you've built an agent, automated a workflow, or created a tool, not just used ChatGPT for email

- Enterprise experience: managed complex orgs, sold to multiple stakeholders

- Close collaboration experience with product and engineering teams

- Self-directed: brings solutions, not just problems

- Balances empathy with commercial impact, willing to challenge the status quo when it blocks results

Nice to Have: Bonus, not required. 

- Experience at a native AI technology company

- Comfort with API integrations, conversation flow design, and business intelligence tools

Not a Fit If: 

- You want a fixed playbook and clear SOPs before you start

- You'd rather support the commercial conversation than own it

- You need close oversight rather than working independently with your deployment strategist as your main partner

Why Siena? 

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values 

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI 

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

How we hire 

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at Siena provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

- Maintain team documentation, briefs, review records, and other operational resources so that information is easy to find and act on

- Create structure around design handoffs, stakeholder reviews, and team rituals to empower designers and improve cross-functional collaboration

- Support continuous improvement through feedback loops, retrospective facilitation, and structured iteration on processes and ways of working

You have a genuine appreciation for design and can build trust with creative, technical, and business partners.

Education: a degree or equivalent practical experience in design operations, UX, project or programme management, business, or a related field.

- Experience supporting a design, research, product, or similarly collaborative team in a complex organisation

- Experience improving workflows, planning cadences, documentation, or operational systems

- Strong planning, facilitation, and project coordination skills

- Ability to analyse how work gets done, identify friction, and turn improvements into practical, repeatable ways of working

- Confidence learning and managing tools, systems, and documentation practices that support design teams

- Collaborative and relationship-oriented, with a calm and constructive approach

- Proactive and dependable, with strong ownership of details and follow-through

- Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-moving, global environment

title: Product Designer
description:

This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance.

That's because multiple studies have shown that the "Creative" itself is responsible for half of sales lift online, higher than reach, targeting, brand, & recency combined. This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We're an end-to-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. We help brands isolate creative elements so they can be analysed against downstream ad impact metrics, from clickthrough rates to brand lift.

Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data.

As a Product Designer, you'll help shape the next generation of the CreativeX platform, taking problems from discovery through to shipped experiences across defined areas of the product. CreativeX is a complex product with rich data, multiple user types and increasingly sophisticated AI capabilities, and as AI increases the volume and speed of creative production, you'll make that complexity work for marketers, helping them measure performance fast, find the patterns behind what's working and see whether their full set of ads is delivering the strategy. - Turn creative data, insights and AI-powered capabilities into intuitive workflows, dashboards and decision-making tools

- Design for the platform, not just the feature, building on existing patterns and connecting experiences across CreativeX

- Use and extend our design system, creating and documenting patterns and components so they're implemented consistently

- Raise the quality bar through strong interaction and visual design craft, and by giving and receiving feedback in critiques

- Learn from what you ship, using customer feedback, product data and research to improve the experience

- Learn the CreativeX platform, our customers and our design system, and work as the design lead in your product trio

- Take ownership of a defined product area and ship, or get build-ready, your first piece of work

- Contribute to our AI-powered product work and add to or improve patterns in our design system

- Join customer conversations and use what you hear to shape your design decisions

In your first year 

- Own design for one or more product areas, taking work from discovery through to launch with little direction

- Ship work you can point to, using customer feedback and product data to show whether it solved the problem

- Help build out new parts of our design system and make the product feel more coherent across areas

- Experience using research, usability testing and customer feedback to inform design decisions

- A systems mindset and the ability to make complex information, workflows and data easy to understand

- Clear, collaborative communication: you challenge ideas constructively, take feedback well and know when to ship and learn

- Experience working closely with Product and Engineering in a product trio or small team, with real ownership

title: Lead Architect - Digital Assets
description:
We are hiring on behalf of our client, an established, leading European regulated financial institution who is expanding its digital assets capabilities to build the next generation of financial market infrastructure. The organization is seeking a Lead Architect – Digital Assets to lead a zero-to-one build, bridging traditional capital markets with decentralised finance (DeFi).

This mandate involves architecting the core platform behind initial tokenised offerings across two major live initiatives currently in design:

- Tokenised Issuance, Trading, and Settlement Platform: Supporting equities, ETFs, and bonds with a 24/7 central limit order book, fractional trading, CCP-cleared trades, and end-of-day atomic DvP settlement on-chain.
- Tokenised Collateral-Management Platform: Designed for sovereign bonds to enable real-time repo, CCP-margin eligibility, and DeFi distribution of government securities through gated lending venues.
The architecture is built on core principles: the token serves as the direct financial instrument, one ISIN corresponds to one ledger, and tokenisation is driven directly by the CSD. The Lead Architect will turn these principles into a concrete, secure, resilient, and auditable infrastructure.

Requirements 

- Architecture & System Design: Own the end-to-end architecture for digital asset solutions, seamlessly integrating distributed ledger technology (DLT) with traditional market infrastructure (trading, clearing, settlement, custody, and CSD).
- Cross-Chain & Network Topology: Design cross-chain topology combining permissioned chains for institutional and CCP operations (e.g., Hyperledger Besu, Canton Network) with public chains for DeFi distribution (Ethereum / L2).
- On-Chain Compliance & Governance: Define regulatory compliance frameworks on-chain, utilizing regulated security-token standards (ERC-3643 / T-REX), KYC-whitelisted wallets, automated transfer restrictions, real-time AML screening (Chainalysis / Elliptic), and transaction reporting under MiFIR.
- Custody & Key Management: Architect robust custody models around MPC solutions (e.g., Fireblocks, Taurus), incorporating hybrid frameworks to support bring-your-own-custody (BYOC) for institutional clients.

title: Senior AI Engineer - Freelance
description:
About Mirakl: 

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com .

Mirakl in Numbers: 

- 🗓️ Founded in 2012 | Member of French Tech Next40

- 👥 750+ employees in 9 offices worldwide: Paris, Barcelona, Bordeaux, Boston, London, Munich, New York, Sydney, Tokyo

- 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France

- ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values: 

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

- 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

- 🏆 Get Things Done: We prioritize action and efficiency for impactful results

- 🚀 Go Above & Beyond: We tackle challenges proactively and always aim for excellence

- 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture

- 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

About the job 

Design, build, and scale production-grade AI systems that power the next generation of intelligent commerce.

You will work at the intersection of Software Engineering, Machine Learning, and Generative AI to build AI-native products, agentic systems, and platform capabilities used by Mirakl customers and internal teams.

This is a freelance position based in Paris or Bordeaux, with 1 day of remote work per week.

Why Now, Why Mirakl 

Generative AI and AI Agents are fundamentally reshaping commerce software and the way our teams work on a day to day basis.

At Mirakl, AI is becoming a core part of our product strategy. From Catalog Transformer and content generation to AI Agents and Agentic Commerce, we are building the next generation of commerce software. And we have the same ambition for our teams around AI products and adoption.

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to transform the way our internal teams work, and to have a significant impact on the agentic side of our Saas products.

You won't be joining a company that's thinking about AI. You'll be joining one that's already building it.

What You'll Do 

1. Design & Build AI Systems 

- Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems for both Mirakl internal operations.

- Develop solutions leveraging: LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Multimodal AI and Evaluation frameworks.

- Architect complex agentic workflows including tools, memory, retrieval, planning, and guardrails.

- Rapidly prototype new capabilities and evolve them into scalable, reliable AI production systems.

2. Integrate Across the Stack 

- Connect AI systems to internal platforms, business applications, and data sources across the company.

- Enable AI agents to interact with systems such as CRM, data platform, Drive, Jira, support tools, and internal knowledge bases.

- Design robust orchestration layers between models, APIs, tools, retrieval systems, and business workflows.

- Ensure reliability, observability, scalability, and maintainability across the entire AI stack.

3. Iterate for Impact 

- Partner with end users, business teams, Product Managers, and Engineers to identify high-value opportunities for AI.

- Run pilots and experiments, gather qualitative and quantitative feedback, and measure business impact.

- Analyze usage patterns, failure modes, costs, latency, and performance metrics.

- Continuously improve accuracy, reliability, adoption, and user experience through data-driven iteration.

4. Ensure Quality, Security & Reliability 

- Implement evaluation frameworks, guardrails, validation layers, and monitoring systems.

- Design AI systems that are secure, explainable, and production-ready.

- Ensure compliance with data security, governance, and access control requirements.

- Document architectures, capabilities, limitations, KPIs, and operational best practices.

5. Drive Adoption & Enablement 

- Build a scalable ecosystem of AI systems and agents that empower both internal teams and customers.

- Support teams in adopting AI-powered workflows and integrating AI into their daily operations.

- Contribute to AI engineering standards, reusable frameworks, and best practices across the company.

- Act as a champion for AI-driven ways of working and help shape Mirakl's transition toward Agentic Commerce.

Our stack and tools 

- 
Languages: Python and SQL

- 
AI Stack: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral and Open-source models

- 
Agentic & Retrieval: LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP and Vector Databases

- Infrastructure: AWS or GCP, Docker and Kubernetes

What Makes You Successful 

- Strong engineering mindset: able to design reliable and scalable systems

- Strong AI expertise: able to translate the latest AI capabilities into production products

- Strong product mindset: able to balance technical excellence with business impact

- Focus on measurable outcomes, not technical complexity

Success Metrics 

- Product adoption and business impact

- Performance and reliability of AI systems

- Quality of AI outputs and evaluation metrics

You'll Love This Job If you have 

- 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, ML Engineering, Applied AI, or related fields

- Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals

- Hands-on experience building production AI systems using LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents

- Experience designing multi-step agentic workflows and retrieval systems

- Experience evaluating AI systems and improving model performance

- Experience deploying and operating production services in cloud environments

- Strong communication skills in English

- Curiosity, pragmatism, and passion for building AI products

Feel free to add a link to your GitHub in your CV so we can understand what you have worked on!

Want to join us? Here is our process 

- A 30-40 min phone conversation with one of our Tech recruiters. This will be an opportunity to discuss your background, expectations, and discover what Mirakl can offer you in return.

- An initial 1h30 technical discussion with a member of the Data Science team and Engineering Team, which will allow you to delve into the more specific aspects of your expertise and discover how your skills can be integrated into our projects.

- 2 x 45-minute "STAR" interviews with future Mirakl colleagues to discuss our values and company culture.

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations. 

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. While AI helps us work efficiently, all final hiring decisions are made by humans. For more information, visit our AI Guidelines for Candidates and Interviews .

title: Mobile Engineer - React Native
description:
🧡 About Alma 

At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started!

👐 About the team 

The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement.

Alma Wallet builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets.

Consumer Engagement drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently.

In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth.

This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to Gautier Labarre , Engineering Manager .

This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France. 

💼 About the job 

- Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences: Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers.

- Make payments simple and secure: Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage.

- Raise the quality bar of the app: Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements.

- Help the team learn and move forward: Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team’s architecture, tooling and release processes.

🧰 You will work with 

- Mobile: Expo / EAS, Expo Router, React Native, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, react-hook-form, Zod, Reanimated, Unistyles, MMKV, Nitro modules.

- Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro. Payments: Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com SDKs.

- Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature.

- Back-end: Python, FastAPI. Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude.

🧩 About you 

To succeed in this job 

- You have 3+ years of experience building mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript , with experience releasing apps on both the App Store and Google Play.

- You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching.

- You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance.

- You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment.

And it will be nice if you also 

- Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications.

- Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale.

- Are comfortable challenging product or back-end implementation when it does not provide the best user or technical outcome.

- Have experience with web development in addition to mobile development.

Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience. 

🧘 What's in it for you 

If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on:

- Work on products at the heart of Alma's strategy, including the Alma card, new payment methods in the app and our loyalty programme.

- Solve real mobile fintech challenges involving payment SDKs, Apple Pay, Google Pay, biometrics and secure storage.

- Use a modern mobile stack based on Expo 57, React Native’s New Architecture, React 19, TypeScript 7, Reanimated 4 and Nitro modules.

🤑 Compensation & benefits 

- Competitive salary based on 12 months

- Profit-sharing and employee savings plan

- Health insurance: 100% covered by Alma including family package

- Disability insurance: 100% covered by Alma

- Sport: partnerships with Gymlib and Classpass, or €30/month reimbursement for your sports activities

- Maternity/paternity leave: salary maintained at 100% during leave with no seniority requirement. Return to work at 4/5 schedule paid at 100% for 8 weeks.

- Sustainable Mobility Package (FMD): €544.80/year (excluding full-remote contracts)

- Meal vouchers: €10/day, 50% covered by Alma

- Mental health: free access to MindDay platform

- Paid time off: 25 days/year (+ additional paid leave granted for employees on executive contracts)

- Access to our Learning & Development Platform

- 2 weeks of full remote possible per year in summer

🎯 Interview Process 

- Video call with a Talent Acquisition team member to understand your path, motivation and present you the role.

- Video call with your future manager to deep dive into the role, the team, your profile and answer all your questions.

- Live testing session with members of the Mobile Engineering team to assess your practical knowledge and approach to mobile development.

- Coffee Chat with members of the squad you would join , with the panel adapted to Alma Wallet or Consumer Engagement.

🌍 Diversity & Inclusion 

At Alma, we believe that diversity fuels innovation and makes our community stronger. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels seen, respected, and empowered to do their best work whatever their gender, background, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, religion, disability or lived experience. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applicants from all walks of life, and all employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.

title: Senior Product Manager - Measurement & Reporting
description:
Streaming TV is no longer just a brand awareness channel. It’s becoming a core part of the performance marketing mix, alongside search and social. Vibe.co is building the platform that makes TV work like the rest of the acquisition stack: targeted, measurable, and optimized for results.

Vibe.co is an Audience First Streaming TV Advertising platform that gives marketers the tools to reach the right audiences, optimize campaigns in real time, and understand what’s actually driving business outcomes. With hyper-targeted segmentation, AI-powered recommendations, real-time optimization, and incrementality measurement, Vibe brings the precision and accountability of digital advertising to the biggest screen in the house.

Today, more than 12,000 brands use Vibe.co to reach 120 million+ households. And in August 2026, Vibe.co became a Walmart company, opening up a new chapter for the business and the industry. With Walmart’s first-party data and purchase signals now part of the Vibe platform, advertisers can connect TV advertising to real-world transactions and measure the impact of CTV with a level of precision previously associated with platforms like Google and Meta.

This is a unique moment to join Vibe. With Walmart’s scale, data, and reach behind us, we’re building the next generation of TV advertising and creating a more measurable, performance-driven future for the channel.

About the Role 

You’ll own Measurement & Reporting: the product surface where Vibe turns campaign delivery into proof. Performance is why clients pick Vibe. Trusted, actionable measurement is why they stay and scale with us.

Reporting to the VP of Product, you’ll own the strategy and roadmap for how Vibe explains and proves the impact of CTV advertising across every vertical. Your main focus will be ecom and CPG, with growing coverage of apps, local, and travel. The goal is to make CTV outcomes as trustworthy and actionable as search and social, so clients confidently move more budget to Vibe.

You’ll work daily with Data Science, Data Platform, Engineering, and our client-facing teams (CS, Sales, TAM). With Walmart’s purchase data now part of the platform, measurement is becoming one of Vibe’s biggest differentiators.

What You’ll Do 

Reporting & Insight 

- Own advertiser-facing reporting, including dashboards, outcome metrics, and exports that make CTV performance clear to both technical and non-technical buyers.

- Turn raw performance data into benchmarks and insights clients can grasp at a glance.

Attribution & Incrementality 

- Productize attribution and incrementality to a client-grade standard, not just an internal signal.

- Own integrations with the measurement tools clients already trust, such as MMPs, web/CAPI pixels, MMM, and third-party partners (e.g. Northbeam, Haus), so Vibe’s numbers hold up next to Meta and Google.

- Guarantee data accuracy, transparent methodology, and defensible results.

Activation 

- Translate measurement into clear recommendations and next actions that drive spend decisions.

- Close the loop between proven outcomes and campaign optimization, powering the “more performance → more spend” flywheel.

- Partner with CS, Sales, and TAM to make measurement the core of how we retain and grow clients.

- Use SQL and log-level data to validate methodologies, size opportunities, and prioritize by impact.

What You Need 

- 5+ years in Product Management on performance AdTech, measurement/attribution, or analytics products.

- Strong grasp of digital measurement (attribution models, incrementality and causal testing, MMM) and of why click-based models break for CTV.

- Solid statistical literacy, including experimental design, holdouts, significance, and confidence intervals.

- A track record of shipping client-facing reporting or insight products, and of making complex data simple and trustworthy for marketers.

- Fluency with outcome KPIs across verticals and with the ecom/CPG performance stack.

- Hands-on SQL and data exploration, and you’re comfortable in technical, data-intensive environments.

- The ability to bridge technical measurement and business/GTM stakeholders.

Why This Role 

- You’ll own the product domain that decides whether clients trust their Vibe spend, and whether they scale it.

- You’ll have a direct line to revenue, because measurement is Vibe’s main lever for retaining and growing clients.

- You’ll shape how an entire category proves CTV as a performance channel.

- You’ll have high autonomy and influence across functions, from data science to clients’ C-suite.

Our Values 

At Vibe, we run on three values: Impact, Ambition, and Urgency. We tie every goal to a real business outcome, think 10x rather than settling for good enough, and move daily rather than waiting for perfect conditions.

You’ll thrive here if you own outcomes without needing direction, default to action, and hold yourself to results, not effort.

This is a high-performance environment with high-performance rewards: you’ll work alongside people who push you, with real ownership over hard problems in a market that’s moving fast.

If that sounds like the best version of your career, we want to meet you.

What We Offer 

The base pay range for this role in Paris is €99,000 – €133,000. We will support relocation to Paris for great candidates.

The base pay range for this role in New York is $108,000 – $216,000. We will support relocation to New York for great candidates.

At Vibe, we want you to build something, own something, and grow fast. Here’s how we back that up:

- Variable pay — Based on real Vibe business goals.

- Hybrid flexibility — We’re in the Heart of Paris and our team is in 3x a week!

- Health insurance — Full coverage via Alan.

- Meal vouchers — Via Swile.

- Annual offsite — The whole team, once a year, somewhere worth the trip.

- Tech Syncs — Engineering and Product meet in person at least quarterly, worldwide.

Our Interview Process 

We respect your time. Here’s exactly what to expect, no surprises, no ghosting.

- Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes. We’ll share more context on the role and team, and learn more about your background and what you’re looking for.

- Hiring Manager Interview — 45 minutes. Meet with the person you’d work with directly and dive deeper into your experience, product background, and approach to the role.

- Technical Discussion — 90 minutes. A deeper conversation covering product thinking, measurement methodology, data reasoning, and a use case relevant to the role.

- Bar Raiser Interview — 30 minutes. Meet with a senior leader at Vibe for a final conversation and an opportunity to ask any remaining questions.

- Offer — We move quickly once we’ve made a decision. We don’t let good decisions sit.

Equal Opportunity

title: Junior Product Designer - UI/UX
description:
You turn complex manufacturing data into interfaces factory teams rely on every day, working side by side with our engineers. 

Ethon was built to eliminate the trillion-dollar waste problem in manufacturing. We are the technology leader in Industrial AI, building agentic workflows that help manufacturers optimize cost, quality, and speed of production. We are a fast-growing team driving massive impact in one of the largest and most under-served industries in the world.

We serve the world's top manufacturers across the globe. From Siemens and Bosch to Lindt and Roche, our customers trust us to make their factories run better. We are backed by leading investors like Index Ventures, General Catalyst, and Earlybird. Our team draws from Google, Meta, Palantir, MBB, and top manufacturing companies, all here for the same reason: giving manufacturers the technology to run every factory at unprecedented productivity.

WHAT IS THIS JOB ABOUT? 

You’ll join our small design team and work directly with our engineers. At first you’ll focus on UI: building screens, components and flows for our platform, and helping our design system grow. Over time you’ll take on larger parts of the product end to end.

This is what you’ll do:

- Turn flows and concepts into detailed production-ready screens.

- Create and maintain components in Figma, keep them in sync with what’s in code, and notice when patterns start to drift.

- Pair with developers, review builds, and make quick trade-offs when something doesn’t fit the sprint. Your designs ship; you don’t just hand off Figma files.

- When a shortcut hurts the experience, you say so, explain why, and propose an alternative. And you know when good enough is good enough.

- Join customer calls and factory visits, test ideas with our forward deployed engineers, and bring what you learn back into the product.

- Help where a startup needs it: website updates, sales decks and marketing visuals now and then.

WHAT DO YOU NEED TO BRING? 

First and foremost, we believe in curious people who are eager to learn and grow. If you're passionate about cutting-edge tech and driving major impact in manufacturing, we want to hear from you.

You don’t need to have done it all. We can teach you manufacturing, our product, and a lot about designing complex B2B software. We can’t teach you to care about the details, or to be curious about how things work.

Must-haves:

- You’re fluent in English and comfortable with changing priorities. You know when to be scrappy and when to be thorough.

- You have 1–3 years of professional experience designing digital products. Internships and working-student roles count if you shipped real work.

- You have strong UI craft and have hands-on experience with a design system.

- You’re fluent in Figma (components, variants, auto layout, variables) and comfortable using AI tools for quick iterations and prototypes.

- You enjoy working closely with developers and understand enough about frontend to design things that can be built.

- You can explain and stand behind your design decisions, and you change your mind when someone has a better argument.

- You’re curious about users, technology and how things get made, and you actively look for feedback so you can grow.

Bonus:

- Experience with B2B SaaS, dashboards or data-heavy products

WHY IS ETHON RIGHT FOR YOU? 

We work from our office in the center of Zürich. You will be here three days a week, because the hardest problems get solved in person.

You’ll work alongside two senior designers, get regular design critiques, and sit close to the engineers who build what you design. Feedback loops are short, access to founders is direct.

Additionally, we offer:

- Performance-based career & growth paths

- On-site work with significant scope for flexible schedules

- Competitive compensation including stock options giving you a stake in Ethon's long-term success

- Vacation bonus if you take two consecutive weeks of vacation

- Flexible parental leave

- Learning budget for courses, conferences, and coaching

If this sounds like your kind of work, we would like to meet you.

We're committed to building a team that reflects the diverse world we live in. We encourage applications from all backgrounds, and we especially welcome voices traditionally underrepresented in tech.

HOW TO APPLY 

Send us your CV and a portfolio with 2–3 case studies, at least one showing detailed UI work. Tell us briefly what you did yourself and what the team did.

Our interview process includes a short design challenge during the on-site, so you can show us how you work.
