title: Project Leider Bouw
description:
Monumental automatiseert de bouw met robotica en software. Onze missie is om de bouw software-defined en autonoom te maken – een toekomst waarin mooie gebouwen op maat in één dag verrijzen, met minimale inzet van handwerk.

We zijn een groeiend team van engineers, operators en technici, afkomstig van bedrijven als Palantir, Qualcomm, Dyson, Shopify, Tesla, Meta en Google DeepMind. We staan nog aan het begin van het opbouwen van dit bedrijf, en dit is je kans om buitenproportioneel veel impact te maken op een probleem dat écht uitmaakt. Vanaf dag één werk je samen met een ervaren foundingteam, met een Series B van $32M achter ons onder leiding van Khosla Ventures en Plural.

Monumental zit in het centrum van Amsterdam, in een prachtig pand met een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats en een eigen testvloer voor robots. We bouwen de hele stack in-house – hardware én software. We zijn uitdrukkelijk geen hybride of remote-first bedrijf: robots en muren bouw je niet vanaf je keukentafel, dus we werken vijf dagen per week op locatie.

Lees meer over waarom wij vinden dat je je tijd aan de bouw zou moeten besteden, en over onze visie en ons bedrijf . Misschien vind je ons YouTube-kanaal interessant, de film van Based in Europe over hoe we het Europese woningtekort aanpakken , of deze video van Andreas Klinger over hoe ons kantoor eruitziet. 

Over de functie 

De afgelopen jaren is Monumental gegroeid van een werkend product en de eerste proefprojecten naar bouwen op grote schaal. Inmiddels hebben we een vloot van meer dan 150 robots, die metselwerk hebben uitgevoerd voor meer dan 90 woningen, een school, een buurthuis, een hotel en meer dan 150 meter kanaalwand.

Elke maand nemen we meer bouwprojecten aan, intern noemen we die ‘deployments’. We werken met meer robots en meer mensen en breiden vanuit Nederland uit naar het Verenigd Koninkrijk en de VS.

Als Hub Lead zet je onze eerste vestiging buiten het hoofdkantoor op, in het noorden van Nederland. Je begint met ons grootste bouwproject tot nu toe. Naarmate er meer projecten bijkomen, bouw je het team en de operatie verder uit. 

We zoeken mensen die breed inzetbaar zijn en een bouwproject willen leiden alsof het hun eigen bedrijf is. Achter elk project staat een Deployment Manager die van begin tot eind verantwoordelijk is. In de praktijk vervul je vijf rollen tegelijk: uitvoerder, operationeel manager, accountmanager, analist en projectmanager. Je maakt het bouwplan, voert het met je team als onderaannemer uit, onderhoudt het contact met de aannemer en zorgt dat we goed metselwerk op tijd opleveren. Dat doe je in de bouw, waar plannen voortdurend veranderen. Uiteindelijk leid je meerdere projecten tegelijk, waaronder complexe projecten waarbij veel op het spel staat.

De ene dag sta je bij zonsopgang op en ga je naar de bouwplaats. Je zaagt stenen, bewaakt de planning, stemt af met de hoofdaannemer en ziet je bouwplan steen voor steen werkelijkheid worden. De volgende dag zit je op onze vestiging, analyseer je de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en werk je aan systemen waarmee je bij het volgende project een betere marge haalt. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de oplevering en geeft knelpunten die je op de bouwplaats tegenkomt door aan ons R&D-team.

Dit is intensief, praktisch werk op locatie, waar je veel voldoening uit kunt halen. Robots gaan kapot, het weer slaat om en de aannemer verandert het plan. Jij zorgt dat de bouw doorgaat.

Je krijgt veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. De rol past goed bij je als je eerder een bedrijf hebt opgericht, of als je een ondernemende functie zoekt waarin je veel invloed hebt op het resultaat.

Wat je gaat doen 

- De logistiek van een bouwproject plannen. Je bepaalt hoeveel en welke robots en mensen nodig zijn, stemt af met andere onderaannemers en maakt de dagelijkse planning. Tegelijk houd je het grotere geheel in het oog en begrijp je wat jouw keuzes betekenen voor de kosten en opbrengsten per project.

- Op de bouwplaats het team aansturen, begeleiden en motiveren. Je onderhoudt het contact met hoofdaannemers en andere betrokkenen, vertegenwoordigt Monumental en legt uit wat we doen. Je schakelt net zo makkelijk met steigerbouwers als met de CEO’s van de grootste hoofdaannemers en onze engineers.

- Operationele systemen opzetten waarmee elk project beter verloopt dan het vorige. Je ziet waar tijd en middelen verloren gaan, past processen aan en verbetert de marge.

- Samenwerken met bestaande klanten en zorgen dat daar nieuwe bouwprojecten uit voortkomen. In de toekomst doe je dat ook voor aanverwante productlijnen buiten het metselwerk.

- Verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de winst- en verliesrekening van je project en voorstellen doen om de kosten en opbrengsten per project steeds verder te verbeteren.

- Helpen bij het werven en interviewen van nieuwe robotoperators en deployment operators.

Wat we zoeken 

- Minimaal drie jaar ervaring startupervaring, als operator, manager, of founder.

- Nederlands als moedertaal. De bouwsector is sterk lokaal georganiseerd, dus dit is een vereiste voor de functie.

- Je communiceert helder en makkelijk met mensen met uiteenlopende achtergronden.

- Je bent bereid om letterlijk je handen vuil te maken om het werk gedaan te krijgen.

- Je komt snel in actie, zet door en krijgt dingen voor elkaar. In deze functie draait het vooral om uitvoeren.

- Je kunt goed omgaan met hoge werkdruk. Op bouwplaatsen gaat regelmatig iets mis en staat er veel op het spel. Daar komt bij dat we nieuwe technologie inzetten waarvan we nog niet alle mogelijke storingen kennen.

- Je denkt scherp en leert graag. Welke achtergrond je ook hebt, je zult in deze rol veel en snel moeten leren. Het werk kan elke drie tot zes maanden als een nieuwe baan voelen. Je leert veel over de bouw, robotica en werken in een snelgroeiend technologiebedrijf.

- Je hebt ervaring met het aansturen van een klein team en weet hoe je mensen begeleidt en motiveert.

- Je bent operationeel en analytisch sterk. Je kunt een helder operationeel plan uitwerken in een spreadsheet, een winst- en verliesrekening presenteren en verschillende scenario’s doorrekenen, inclusief de factoren die het resultaat bepalen. Je bent een sterke projectmanager.

Waarom Monumental? 

Bij Monumental werken betekent vooroplopen in een beweging die de bouwsector wezenlijk wil veranderen. Jouw werk heeft hier niet alleen impact op het bedrijf, maar op de toekomst van hoe we bouwen. Als je gedreven wordt door innovatie, graag complexe uitdagingen aanpakt en klaar bent om echt verschil te maken, horen we graag van je.

Voor open sollicitaties (als je geen rol ziet die precies past) kun je ons mailen op: 

Helaas bieden we op dit moment geen stageplekken aan.

Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen hierboven, maar ben je enthousiast over Monumental en denk je dat je ons toch kunt helpen moeilijke problemen op te lossen? Neem dan contact op. We verwelkomen generalisten die op resultaat gericht zijn en graag on the job leren.

title: Director, Expanded Access Program Operations
description:
About myTomorrows 

myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. 

We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. 

We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. 

With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. 

Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today.

Beyond ensuring quality, compliance, speed, and resilience, you’ll be expected to think like an entrepreneur: spotting opportunities, optimising processes, and driving commercially sound decisions that enable sustainable growth.

You’ll be a core member of the Operations Leadership Team and report directly to our COO (Vanessa says hi). This role is perfect for someone who thrives on complexity, builds high‑performing teams, and raises the operational bar—while balancing patient‑first decision‑making with a strong commercial mindset.

Geographic Requirement: This role is open to candidates in The Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada and USA. For candidates in North America , to ensure seamless collaboration with our teams, applicants must reside within the EST or CST time zones .

What you'll do in this role: 

- Own the end-to-end operating model for EAP Program + Site Management, ensuring scalable and compliant delivery

- Translate strategy and portfolio forecasts into capacity planning, org design and hiring priorities

- Build resilient coverage and escalation models across the portfolio (no single points of failure)

- Lead the EAP Program Management team to deliver consistent execution across clients and geographies

- Lead the EAP Site Management team to ensure strong site engagement, workload balance and service performance

- Drive standardisation and continuous improvement across ways of working, tooling and operational excellence

- Set and run a strong governance rhythm: KPIs, performance reviews, risk management and quality oversight

- Grow a bar-raising leadership bench through coaching, performance management and succession planning

What you bring to the table: 

- You have 8–10+ years experience leading and managing expanded access programs.

- Experience in a market access setting and with multi-country reimbursement strategies is a plus.

- You understand the EAP business, and have a strong and proven commercial and client service mindset.

- You have proven experience building and leading high performance teams.

- You know how to lead managers and scale operational teams in complex settings

- You have an exceptionally strong understanding of compliance, regulatory frameworks and operational requirements in the context of Expanded Access Programs

- You have a track record of operational excellence: scaling delivery, managing risk, and raising performance standards

- You are a strategic thinker with strong execution focus — you simplify complexity and drive outcomes

- You are a confident stakeholder manager who can align senior leaders and external partners

- You hold a high bar for quality and accountability, with calm leadership under pressure

- Have full grip on the EAP portfolio and delivery realities — and you can clearly articulate the biggest operational opportunities and risks (and have recommendations on how to address them)

- Create clarity across Program & Site Management: ownership, workflows, escalation paths, and what “great” looks like

- Have made at least 1–2 concrete operational improvements (process / tooling / standardisation) that measurably improve delivery outcomes

- Are seen as a trusted Operations Leadership Team member who raises the bar and builds momentum.

Equal opportunities 

myTomorrows is an Equal Opportunity Employer and, beyond upholding discrimination-free practices, we are committed to cultivating a workplace where difference and diversity are protected and celebrated. The best work comes from our best selves, and we go to great lengths in supporting our team members to be just that.

title: Team Lead, Data Engineering
description:
We are looking for a Data Engineering Team Lead to lead the Data Platform team at DataSnipper.

Every decision DataSnipper makes about its products runs through the data platform: which features land, which customers are getting value, what we bill for, what we fix next, and which AI capabilities add the most value. You will lead a team of two data engineers who own the systems that make that possible. That means how usage events get captured across a growing set of products, how they become trustworthy models in Snowflake, and how Customer Success, Product and GTM get to answers without waiting on us.

This is a player-coach role in a small, high-ownership team . You are responsible for the people, the roadmap and the technical direction, and you stay hands-on enough to ship alongside the team and make architectural calls credibly. At DataSnipper, Team Lead is our entry point into engineering management: the same people, delivery and product responsibilities as an Engineering Manager, on a smaller team.

We are a handful of people serving the whole company, so your judgment about what not to build matters as much as what the team ships.

About DataSnipper

DataSnipper is the driving force behind an intelligent automation platform that’s transforming the world of audit and finance.

Founded in 2017, DataSnipper has skyrocketed and is now OFFICIALLY the fastest-growing software company in the Netherlands according to Deloitte Fast50 and recently achieved Unicorn status in our latest funding round. With over 400.000 users in 125+ countries and a second base in the heart of New York City, DataSnipper is shaking things up. And we’re not stopping there. At DataSnipper, we’re always on the lookout for innovators who think outside of the box. New ideas aren’t just welcomed at DataSnipper–they’re essential.

What your team owns

The Data Platform team works across three areas:

- Data Platform : reliable, scalable infrastructure that gets the right data to the right place

- Internal Analytics : a self-service platform so every team can be data-informed without a ticket

- Customer-facing Analytics : the dashboards and exports customers use to see the value they get from DataSnipper

Concretely, you would be walking into billions of usage events flowing from our Excel Add-in, web apps and product backends through Azure Event Hubs into Snowflake ; a dbt estate built on medallion principles and managed in dbt Cloud ; Terraform-managed Snowflake and Azure infrastructure; and a set of product teams shipping AI agents faster than we can instrument them .

You will also find real, named open problems rather than a tidy platform: event capture mid-consolidation, multiple methods of user attribution, and a data quality layer that is designed but not yet built. We would rather tell you that up front.

What you will do

Lead the team

- Lead a team of two data engineers through outcomes, not tasks : set clear goals with the team and trust them to figure out how

- Make the team measurably better: raise the engineering bar, grow each engineer into bigger problems, and address performance issues directly when they arise

- Run regular 1:1s, give clear and timely feedback, and own each engineer's goals and development

- Foster a culture of experimentation, learning, documentation and operational excellence

- Take part in hiring and help shape the team's scope as it evolves

Own direction and delivery

- Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success and GTM to shape the team's roadmap , turning vague data requests into scoped, well-defined work

- Make the trade-offs a small team serving the whole company needs: what to build, what to defer, and when a request shouldn't become a pipeline

- Set the technical direction and make the architectural calls that shape the team's systems

- Keep Snowflake performance and cost , tech debt, dependencies and compliance obligations (audit logging, vulnerability remediation, Vanta evidence) visible and under control

- Be the person other engineering teams come to when they need to instrument something new

Stay hands-on in the data platform

- Contribute to the event ingestion architecture end to end: Azure Event Hubs, Snowpipe, Fivetran, and our shared Python/TypeScript event client libraries

- Build and review dbt transformation pipelines that stay reliable as volume, source count and model complexity grow

- Define and enforce event contracts and schemas so product teams can instrument new features without silent breakage downstream

- Evolve the core data models (event, user, license, company) and integrate new sources such as product backends, MongoDB, HubSpot and billing

- Guide reverse ETL and activation work that pushes modeled data back into HubSpot, MongoDB, Postgres and GTM reporting

What you bring

Leadership

- At least 1 year leading engineers as a team lead or engineering manager: 1:1s, feedback, goal setting, performance, and development

- An empowerment style of leadership : you lead through outcomes and trust, not by assigning tasks

- Early evidence of growing engineers and raising a team's bar, and the willingness to address performance issues directly

- Strong product aptitude : you can challenge the framing of a request, translate stakeholder needs into technical solutions, and make roadmap trade-offs

Data engineering

- 7+ years in data engineering or a closely related backend/platform role, with a track record of owning a data platform area end to end

- Deep SQL and strong Python , including query optimization and performance tuning on a cloud warehouse

- Production experience with a cloud data warehouse (we use Snowflake ) and a modern transformation framework (we use dbt )

- Experience with event-driven / streaming ingestion and its failure modes: schema drift, duplication, late data, backfills

- Experience on a cloud platform at the infrastructure level (we're on Azure ; AWS/GCP transfers fine)

- Solid data modeling fundamentals and the ability to defend a modeling decision to both engineers and business stakeholders

- Experience operating data systems in production with a focus on reliability, observability and maintainability

How you work

- Excellent communication in English and genuine comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders

- Bias to action, a strong sense of ownership, and the judgment to prioritize when demand exceeds capacity

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in a startup or scale-up , ideally as an early member of a data team

- Experience hiring engineers or helping a team expand its scope

- Experience with product analytics tooling (Mixpanel, RudderStack) and warehouse-native BI (Netspring/Optimizely Analytics, Omni, Embeddable, or similar)

- Experience building data products for AI or agent consumption : semantic layers, metrics layers, MCP servers, or governed self-service access

- Experience with Terraform , Docker and data governance at scale

- Reverse ETL experience and familiarity with CRM data models (HubSpot, Salesforce) or customer success platforms

What we offer

- Being part of one of the fastest-growing scale-ups in the Netherlands

- Make an impact by disrupting the audit industry with us

- A step into engineering management, with Engineering Manager scope on a small team

- Excellent salary

title: Director - Power Systems and Grid Transformation
description:
Company Description: Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.

As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.

Director, Power Systems & Grid Transformation 

Location: Amsterdam ( preferred), or London 
Reports to: Eveline Speelman, Global Energy Platform Lead
Role type: Full-time

Role Overview 

Systemiq is seeking a Director with deep expertise in power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, system planning, flexibility, market design, utility transformation, and the integration of renewables at scale.

This role will help clients address some of the most critical bottlenecks in the energy transition: grid constraints, connection queues, system adequacy, flexibility markets, transmission and distribution investment, regulatory reform, and the changing role of utilities and system operators.

This is not a generalist energy transition role. We are looking for a senior strategy leader who understands how power systems actually work technically, commercially, and institutionally, and who can help clients unlock the grid, market, and system integration challenges now slowing the transition.

This is a senior leadership role combining:

- Deep power systems expertise

- Top-tier strategy problem solving

- Origination and senior client leadership

- Delivery of complex, multi-stakeholder programmes

- Team leadership and platform-building

You will work closely with Eveline Speelman and global partners to build Systemiq’s work on power system transformation, with a particular focus on grids, flexibility, market design, utilities, and system-level decarbonisation.

Key Responsibilities 

Power Systems & Grid Transformation 

- Lead work on power system transformation, including grid constraints, transmission and distribution investment, system planning, flexibility, renewables integration, and utility transformation.

- Advise clients on the strategic, regulatory, commercial, and institutional choices needed to accelerate power system decarbonisation.

- Translate technical power system challenges into clear strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.

- Identify the practical barriers slowing power system transformation and shape interventions to overcome them.

Strategic Advisory 

- Lead high-impact strategy engagements with corporates, governments, investors, utilities, system operators, and other energy system actors.

- Structure and solve complex, ambiguous problems and translate them into actionable recommendations.

- Advise senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders and policymakers, on transition pathways, investment priorities, and market-shaping decisions.

Systems Change & Platform Leadership 

- Shape and drive system-level interventions beyond individual projects, including coalitions, market-shaping initiatives, and public-private collaboration.

- Identify structural bottlenecks across policy, infrastructure, regulation, market design, and capital allocation.

- Work across sectors and stakeholders to unlock system-wide impact beyond project-level outcomes.

- Contribute to Systemiq’s broader Energy platform strategy and thought leadership.

Origination & Growth 

- Identify, shape, and win new work across power systems, grids, utilities, flexibility, and energy transition topics.

- Build trusted relationships with senior clients, partners, and external stakeholders.

- Contribute to scaling Systemiq’s Energy platform globally.

Team Leadership 

- Lead and mentor high-performing teams.

- Coach and develop team members, building capability in power systems, analytical problem solving, and systems-level thinking.

- Contribute to a collaborative, entrepreneurial, and mission-driven culture.

Candidate Profile 

We are looking for a high-calibre, strategy-led leader with deep power systems expertise and the ability to operate at the intersection of strategy, policy, regulation, infrastructure, and real-economy delivery.

Essential Experience 

- Deep experience in power systems, ideally including transmission and distribution grids, system operation, power market design, flexibility, renewables integration, storage, demand response, or utility strategy

- Around 10 to 15+ years’ experience in strategy consulting or energy advisory

- Experience working with or advising utilities, TSOs, DSOs, regulators, energy ministries, market operators, developers, infrastructure investors, or major energy users.

- Strong understanding of how grid constraints, interconnection, flexibility, storage, demand response, market reform, and regulation affect decarbonisation pathways.

- Ability to translate technical power system issues into strategic choices for senior decision-makers.

- Proven track record leading strategy engagements, complex programmes, and senior client relationships.

- Demonstrated ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including C-suite leaders, policymakers, regulators, and investors.

- Experience combining advisory work with real-world implementation is strongly valued.

Core Capabilities 

- Exceptional problem structuring and analytical rigour.

- Strong commercial judgement and experience in origination and growth.

- Ability to move between high-level strategy and practical implementation.

- Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

- Systems thinker focused on practical, scalable, real-world outcomes.

- Ability to lead complex work across multiple stakeholders, sectors, and geographies.

Desirable Experience 

- Experience in international energy systems, infrastructure investment, large-scale transition programmes, or power market reform.

- Experience with digital, AI, or advanced analytical tools that improve insight generation, modelling, or delivery efficiency.

- Experience building new areas of work, propositions, or client relationships.

Mindset 

- Entrepreneurial and opportunity-driven.

- Comfortable with ambiguity and building new areas of work.

- Collaborative, low ego, and mission-driven.

- Pragmatic, intellectually rigorous, and focused on real-world impact.

Why This Role Matters 

Power systems are now one of the central constraints in the energy transition. Renewables, electrification, storage, flexibility, industrial decarbonisation, and clean technology deployment all depend on power systems evolving faster than they are today.

This role sits at the centre of that challenge. It will help clients and partners address the grid, market, regulatory, and institutional barriers that determine whether economy-wide decarbonisation can happen at the pace required.

About the role 

WPP Enterprise Solutions in Amsterdam is the central hub for SEO and GEO expertise across the WPP network. From our team, we work with major national and international organisations on complex challenges across search, websites, digital platforms and AI-driven discovery.

Our team currently consists of ten SEO and GEO specialists and is growing rapidly. We are therefore looking for a Senior Technical SEO Specialist to strengthen our technical capabilities.

This is explicitly not a traditional SEO role with some technical SEO added on top. We are looking for someone who approaches SEO from a technical perspective. Someone who understands how websites, platforms, JavaScript frameworks, crawlers, rendering, APIs and search engines interact, and who can independently investigate and solve complex technical problems.

You are comfortable working with SEO specialists, developers, solution architects, product teams and other technical stakeholders. You are able to go deep into the technology when needed, while also translating complex findings into clear priorities, recommendations and implementations for enterprise clients.

What you will do 

As a Senior Technical SEO Specialist, you will be responsible for the technical quality and scalability of our SEO solutions. You will work on complex websites and digital ecosystems where standard SEO checklists are simply not enough.

Your responsibilities will include: 

- Conducting advanced technical SEO audits for large and complex websites, platforms and international domain structures.

- Analysing crawling, indexing and rendering to identify the root causes of technical SEO and indexation issues.

- Working with modern JavaScript frameworks and rendering architectures, including SSR, CSR, SSG and hybrid rendering.

- Analysing HTML, JavaScript, HTTP requests, response headers, status codes, redirects, canonicalisation and robots directives.

- Investigating and optimising crawl architecture, internal linking and information architecture for websites with hundreds of thousands or millions of URLs.

- Advising on complex technical challenges involving migrations, replatforming, URL structures, faceted navigation, pagination, internationalisation and hreflang.

- Performing log file analysis to understand how Googlebot and other crawlers interact with websites and to improve crawl efficiency.

- Developing scripts, tooling and automation that make recurring analyses faster, more reliable and more scalable.

- Reviewing technical solutions, specifications and implementations from an SEO perspective before they go live.

- Working closely with developers and engineering teams to translate SEO recommendations into clear technical requirements and tickets.

The technical expertise we are looking for 

For this role, we are looking for someone whose technical capabilities go well beyond using standard SEO tools.

You have a strong understanding of: 

- HTML, CSS and JavaScript, and can independently analyse source code and identify technical issues.

- HTTP and web architecture, including requests and responses, status codes, caching, redirects, headers and CDN behaviour.

- JavaScript SEO and the implications of client-side and server-side rendering for crawling, rendering and indexing.

- Technical concepts such as SSR, CSR, SSG, hydration and dynamic rendering.

- Crawling and indexing, and how search engines technically process websites.

- txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, meta robots, X-Robots-Tag and other crawling and indexing directives.

- Structured data and Schema.org.

- Core Web Vitals and web performance.

- International websites, hreflang and complex multi-market architectures.

- Website and platform migrations.

- Crawl budget and scalable website architectures.

You do not need to be a software engineer in every area. However, we do expect you to be comfortable reading code, manipulating data, working with APIs and building scripts or technical solutions when needed.

What seniority means to us

Being senior means more than being able to independently deliver a technical SEO audit.

We expect you to be able to break down complex technical problems where there is no obvious answer. You combine experience, data and technical knowledge to define your own investigative approach and develop solutions that can realistically scale within enterprise organisations.

You will also:

- Proactively improve the way we work, using tooling and AI to increase efficiency, quality and impact.

- Make significant improvements to our SEO guidelines, workflows and processes.

- Develop innovative solutions to complex SEO challenges, including algorithm changes, large-scale site architecture, crawling and automation.

- Build frameworks, templates, scripts and automations that can be adopted across multiple clients and projects.

- Independently develop new approaches for challenges where no standard solution exists.

- Think beyond what needs to change and consider how solutions can be technically and organisationally implemented at scale.

- Help other SEO specialists grow their technical capabilities.

Act as a senior technical sparring partner for our clients.

What you'll need: 

- 10+ years of experience in Technical SEO, with a strong track record of solving complex technical SEO challenges for large-scale, international and/or enterprise websites.

- Currently based in the Netherlands and able to work from our WPP office in Amsterdam.

- Deep technical knowledge of how modern websites are built, crawled, rendered and indexed, including strong expertise in HTML, JavaScript, HTTP, web architecture and rendering technologies.

- Strong experience working with l arge and complex website architectures, including crawling and indexation, faceted navigation, internationalisation, migrations, internal linking and crawl budget optimisation.

- Experience with Python and/or JavaScript for scripting and automation is highly desirable, as is experience with SQL, BigQuery or comparable data environments.

- A proven ability to turn complex technical findings into clear, actionable recommendations for developers, product teams, architects and senior stakeholders.

- Experience developing scalable frameworks, tooling, templates or automations that can be applied across multiple clients or projects.

- An eager and proactive mindset, with a strong interest in exploring how AI, automation, emerging search technologies and GEO can improve both our work and our clients' performance.

- Fluent in English. Dutch is highly desirable.

What we offer: 

We offer a competitive salary, a vibrant and collaborative culture and ample opportunities for professional growth. You'll be part of a global network of talent, working on projects that truly make an impact. 

Our compensation:

- Employee discounts and access to WPP/VML global benefits ecosystem. 

- Participation in team events, agency gatherings and cross-discipline workshops.

With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. title: Process Automation Engineer
description:
Functieprofiel 

Als Process Automation Engineer speel je een cruciale rol in het hart van onze productieomgeving. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het beheren, onderhouden en continu verbeteren van het procesautomatiseringslandschap (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3 – zowel hardware als software).

Je borgt de betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van onze productieprocessen en vertaalt data en technologie naar slimme, praktische verbeteringen die de organisatie vooruithelpen. Dit is een hands‑on functie met veel impact, waarin je nauw samenwerkt met Operations, Production Support Engineering en externe technologiepartners.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 

NX Filtration bevindt zich in een spannende groeifase, gedreven door een unieke en impactvolle technologie. Met onze missie “pure en betaalbare wateroplossingen voor iedereen” ontwikkelen en produceren wij geavanceerde holle‑vezelmembranen voor nano‑, ultra‑ en microfiltratie.

Onze technologie verwijdert de kleinste verontreinigingen uit water, waaronder nanoplastics, organische stoffen, kleurstoffen, medicijnresten, bacteriën en virussen. Hiermee maken wij eenvoudige, efficiënte en duurzame oplossingen mogelijk voor waterzuivering, hergebruik van afvalwater en drinkwaterproductie wereldwijd. Door bij NX Filtration te werken, draag je direct bij aan het oplossen van mondiale uitdagingen op het gebied van waterkwaliteit en waterschaarste.

Wat ga jij doen! 

In deze dynamische rol houd je je bezig met:

- Beheren, onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van procesautomatiseringssystemen (ISA‑niveaus 1, 2 en 3)

- Continu verbeteren van het NX Production Data Platform

- Initiëren, uitwerken en implementeren van technische verbeteringen en procesoptimalisaties

- Ondersteunen van Operations bij automatiseringsincidenten, inclusief deelname aan de storingsdienst

- Zorgen voor een hoge beschikbaarheid en kwaliteit van productie‑ en QC‑data en actieve ondersteuning van data‑analyses

- Voorstellen van automatisering‑ en digitaliseringsprojecten en – na goedkeuring – deze voorbereiden en uitvoeren

- Adviseren van de organisatie over nieuwe technologische ontwikkelingen en toekomstbestendige oplossingen

- Actief bijdragen aan het versterken van cybersecurity binnen het OT‑domein

Wat wij vragen! 

- Jij bent een proactieve automatiseringsprofessional met een passie voor technologie en verbetering:

- Een afgeronde bachelor‑ of masteropleiding in Informatica, Elektrotechniek, Mechatronica of een vergelijkbare richting

title: Product Manager
description:

Bluerock TMS builds the autonomous orchestration platform that keeps global logistics moving — orchestrating complex, multi-modal transport networks for customers across fashion, food & beverage, manufacturing, healthcare, and more. Real complexity, at real scale, every single day. 

We're looking for a Product Manager who has actually lived inside logistics or TMS operations. Someone who can understand operations complexity and who is willing to take on this challenge and contribute hands on to build the next level of TMS. You'll own the products that turn that complexity into clarity, working shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering, sales, and implementation to make sure what we build actually gets adopted. 

Responsibilities 

- Product vision, grounded in real user needs 

You dig past what customers ask for to find the problem underneath, and turn that into a direction for your area the company can rally behind. 

- Market scoping and opportunity-spotting 

Scanning the logistics landscape, competitor moves, and customer signals to find where Bluerock should build next, not just what's already on the backlog. 

- Logistics know-how turned into product decisions 

Planning, transport execution, freight, last-mile — decisions that hold up against how operations actually run, not just how they're described to you. 

- The full lifecycle 

From first idea to adoption. You don't hand off and disappear. 

- The connective tissue across the company 

When priorities compete or a customer escalation needs an answer fast, you're the one pulling the threads together. 

The team you’ll join 

You'll join an international product team with complementary skills and a shared passion for a good challenge, real, hands-on experience in logistics paired with genuine enthusiasm for technology. We don't settle for quick patches: we strive for quality, look for the sustainable solution over the easy one, and keep an eye on what next-level TMS should look like, not just what's in front of us today. 

Life at Bluerock 

We're a distributed team across the Netherlands, Italy, the US, and Canada that operates like one crew: local insight, global perspective. We're curious by default, self-driven without needing to be told twice, and genuinely joyful about solving hard logistics problems together. We're team-minded because the best answers rarely come from one person alone, and unapologetically reliable because our customers' supply chains don't get a “we'll fix it next sprint.” As one of us put it: at the end of the day, it's the people that make Bluerock.

We are looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager (Underwater Security) to drive our go-to-market strategy, accelerate growth, and strengthen our position in the rapidly evolving underwater security market.

Optics11 is a fast-growing technology company developing advanced fiber-optic sensing solutions for some of the world’s most demanding environments.

Within our Underwater Security business, we develop innovative sensing technologies that help detect and monitor underwater threats. Our solutions include OptiBarrier, designed for immediate, over-the-horizon threat detection, and OptiArray, our low-power optical thin-line towed array for unmanned underwater vehicles and submarines.

As our business continues to grow internationally, we are looking for a Senior Growth Marketing Manager to strengthen our commercial growth and demand generation capabilities.

About the role: 

This is a senior, hands-on B2B marketing role with a clear commercial focus.

You will take ownership of our growth marketing and digital demand engine, turning market interest into engaged target accounts and qualified pipeline.

From ABM and integrated campaigns to HubSpot, content, LinkedIn and customer journeys, you will connect our marketing activities into one measurable growth approach.

Working closely with Sales, Product, Engineering and Events, you will help us reach the right accounts, build engagement throughout long and complex buying cycles, and continuously improve how Marketing contributes to commercial growth.

What will you do? 

- Own and execute our B2B growth, demand generation and account-based marketing (ABM) strategy.

- Build targeted campaigns around priority accounts, audiences, products and different stages of the buying journey.

- Lead campaigns end to end – from concept and planning to launch, optimization, reporting and scaling.

- Develop integrated campaigns across content, LinkedIn, email, webinars, landing pages, website and events.

- Own our content marketing approach and work with Product, Engineering and Sales to turn complex technical topics into clear and compelling content.

- Optimize the customer journey from first interaction through lead, MQL and SQL to qualified opportunity.

- Own and continuously improve HubSpot, including lead scoring, workflows, nurture campaigns, lifecycle stages, reporting and attribution.

- Drive website conversion, organic and paid LinkedIn, SEO and other relevant digital marketing activities.

- Measure account engagement, conversion and pipeline performance and turn insights into concrete improvements.

- Manage relevant agencies and external marketing partners.

What we offer 

- A senior role with significant ownership and the opportunity to shape our growth marketing approach.

- The chance to work with innovative technology with real-world applications in underwater security.

- An international, fast-growing working environment.

- 30 vacation days per year.

- Employer pension contribution.

Who are you? 

You are strategic but hands-on. You can define the growth strategy, but you are equally comfortable building the campaign, improving a HubSpot workflow or digging into performance data yourself.

You are commercially driven and focused on meaningful outcomes: engaged accounts, qualified opportunities and measurable pipeline.

You are analytical, curious and comfortable experimenting, learning from data and continuously improving your approach. And because our technology is complex, you can quickly understand technical concepts and translate them into clear and credible stories for different audiences.

What do you bring? 

- Strong hands-on experience in B2B growth marketing, demand generation or a similar senior marketing role.

- Experience working with complex, multi-stakeholder B2B buying cycles.

- Proven experience with account-based marketing (ABM) and close collaboration with Sales.

- Strong experience owning and executing end-to-end marketing campaigns.

- Hands-on experience with HubSpot, including campaigns, lead scoring, workflows, nurture, reporting and attribution.

- Experience across content marketing, LinkedIn, website conversion, SEO and email marketing.

- A strong track record of connecting marketing activities to account engagement, qualified pipeline and commercial outcomes.

- Strong stakeholder management skills and confidence working across commercial and technical teams.

Nice to have 

- Experience marketing complex technical products or solutions.

- Experience within underwater security, maritime, defense, critical infrastructure, offshore energy or adjacent industries.

- Experience working with government, naval, security, procurement or other complex stakeholder environments.

Interested? 

We would love to hear from experienced B2B marketers who combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution and want to build measurable growth in a complex, technology-driven market. Apply and help us shape the next stage of growth for Optics11 Underwater Security.

title: Senior Product Manager Software
description:
About Optics11 

Optics11 is a fast-growing high-tech company based in Amsterdam, developing advanced fiber optic sensing systems for the most demanding environments. Our technology detects the earliest signs of failure in critical assets – from high-voltage energy infrastructure to subsea and defense applications – and gives our customers precise, real-time data they can act on.

The Role 

As Senior Product Manager Software you will build a deep understanding of the software we supply to our defense partners and clients.

You will have full product ownership including strategy, roadmap, and lifecycle and contribute to adjacent hardware product strategy and propositions to, jointly with our hardware product managers, build end-to-end solutions for our defense partners and clients. You build and structure our product discovery and delivery ways of working for the software domain.

You will be part of the Product team in Underwater Security and work closely with our hardware Product Managers, Data science, Software, R&D, Engineering Sales, Projects and Application Engineering teams.

No two weeks will look the same. You might speak with a defense partner about an operational challenge, turn feedback from a deployed product into a roadmap decision, test the feasibility of a new capability with System Engineering, or work with the Product Owner to translate priorities into executable increments. You will also collaborate with hardware Product Managers, Engineering, Sales and Customer Projects to ensure our software and hardware come together as one coherent solution.

You will own the software product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle, from discovery and business case through prioritization, delivery and performance.

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have established a clear, evidence-based software strategy, strengthened our discovery and delivery practices, and aligned teams around the capabilities that matter most. Your work will reduce uncertainty, improve investment decisions and help Optics11 deliver scalable, commercially strong software products that solve real problems for customers operating in demanding, high-stakes environments.

Key Responsibilities 

• Own the software product strategy by defining and articulating the direction for assigned software products or value streams, identifying customer problems and market opportunities, and balance near-term opportunities with long-term company goals.

• Provide product design authority by ensuring software concepts, capabilities and development choices remain aligned with the Underwater Security product vision and strategy throughout the product lifecycle.

• Lead customer and market discovery by developing a deep understanding of customer needs, operational use cases and buying contexts, validating direction with customers and partners, and synthesizing feedback from deployed products.

• Own software roadmap development and prioritization by defining the capabilities required to address validated needs, balancing improvements, new functionality and technology evolution, and communicating priorities across relevant teams.

• Develop business cases and commercial input by defining success measures and commercial objectives, providing evidence for portfolio investment decisions, and supporting Product Marketing with product knowledge for pricing and launch readiness.

• Coordinate the product core team by working with System Engineering on requirements and feasibility, Product Ownership on executable increments, and Project Management on customer delivery, while aligning Sales, Business Development, Customer Projects and Engineering around progress, quality and outcomes.

• Master’s degree in engineering or design, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of experience in Software Product Management, with a proven track record of developing, deploying and maintaining software (platform) driven solutions in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Strong understanding of software products, particularly in complex and regulated environments, e.g., industrial environments.

• In-depth knowledge of software product management and – strategy methodologies.

• Demonstratable experience in defining software product strategy and creating complete business cases.

• Strong cross-functional leadership and stakeholder management skills at operational and management level

• Demonstrated critical thinking, adaptability to challenges, and a problem-solving mindset to creatively address user pain points.

• Proficiency in software industry standard tooling for software development and road mapping such as Jira / Jira Product Discovery / Jira Service Management, Confluence, BigPicture

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills, capable of conveying product level knowledge, decisions and roadmaps to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Willingness to travel

• Drivers’ license B (or international equivalent)

Nice to Have 

• Experience in defense industry or another industrial high-tech / high compliance environment

• Proficiency in JAMA Connect, Siemens Polarion, SAFe, Miro, Figma, Dovetail, Amplitude, PowerBI

• Proficiency in Dutch language is a plus

Security screening 

You'll be working with clients in the defense and security sectors, obtaining a Certificate of No Objection issued by the AIVD (Dutch General Intelligence and Security Service) is mandatory. This means you will need to undergo a security screening. For more information, please check:

title: Masseur / Physiotherapeuth (m/w/d) - Deimann Spa
description:
Wenn ein Gast nach einer Behandlung tiefenentspannt den Deimann Spa verlässt, ist genau das der Moment, in dem Ihre Arbeit spürbar wird. Mit fachlichem Können, Ruhe und einem sicheren Gespür für die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste machen Sie aus einer Massage oder Wellnessanwendung eine wertvolle Auszeit.

Im Deimann Spa, dem Wellnessbereich unseres 5-Sterne-Superior-Hotels im Sauerland, verbinden wir professionelle Anwendungen mit herzlicher persönlicher Betreuung. Sie arbeiten in einem hochwertigen Umfeld, in dem Qualität nicht nur bei der Behandlung zählt, sondern auch in jedem Kontakt mit unseren Gästen.

Aufgaben

- Führen Sie klassische und wellnessorientierte Massageanwendungen professionell und mit einem sicheren Gespür für die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste durch.

- Setzen Sie Ihr fachliches Wissen bei physiotherapeutischen Anwendungen ein, sofern diese Ihrer Qualifikation entsprechen, und begleiten Sie unsere Gäste verantwortungsvoll auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Wohlbefinden.

- Beraten Sie unsere Gäste individuell zu passenden Massage- und Wellnessanwendungen und finden Sie gemeinsam mit ihnen die Behandlung, die zu ihren persönlichen Bedürfnissen passt.

- Erkennen Sie im Rahmen Ihrer fachlichen Qualifikation die individuellen Bedürfnisse unserer Gäste und stimmen Sie Ihre Behandlung entsprechend darauf ab.

- Betreuen Sie unsere Gäste während ihres gesamten Aufenthalts im Deimann Spa aufmerksam, herzlich und professionell.

- Bereiten Sie die Behandlungsräume sorgfältig vor und nach, damit jede Anwendung in einer ruhigen, gepflegten und hochwertigen Atmosphäre stattfinden kann.

- Sichern Sie durch Ihre sorgfältige Arbeitsweise die hohen Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards unseres Spa-Bereichs.

- Arbeiten Sie eng mit Ihrem Spa-Team zusammen und tragen Sie dazu bei, dass unsere Gäste fachlich kompetent und persönlich aufmerksam betreut werden.

- Gestalten Sie mit Ihrer Arbeit ein Spa-Erlebnis, das unseren Gästen Ruhe, Entspannung und die besondere Qualität des Hotel Deimann vermittelt.

- Arbeiten Sie überwiegend tagsüber bis in die Abendstunden, regulär bis etwa 19:00 Uhr. Auch Sonn- und Feiertage gehören zu Ihrem Arbeitsalltag.

Qualifikation

- Sie verfügen über eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Masseur/in, Physiotherapeut/in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, damit Sie unsere Gäste fachlich kompetent und verantwortungsvoll behandeln können.

- Sie bringen idealerweise praktische Erfahrung in Massage, Physiotherapie, Wellness oder einem Spa mit – aber auch als Berufseinsteiger/in sind Sie willkommen, wenn Ihre fachliche Qualifikation und Ihre Haltung zu uns passen.

- Sie verfügen über fachliche Kompetenz und arbeiten sorgfältig, weil hochwertige Massage- und Wellnessanwendungen ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Präzision erfordern.

- Sie haben Freude am direkten Kontakt mit Menschen, weil eine gute Spa-Behandlung nicht nur von der richtigen Technik, sondern ebenso von Aufmerksamkeit und Einfühlungsvermögen lebt.

- Sie arbeiten serviceorientiert und aufmerksam, damit sich unsere Gäste während ihrer gesamten Behandlung persönlich wahrgenommen und bestens aufgehoben fühlen.

- Sie treten gepflegt und professionell auf, weil Ihr persönliches Auftreten wesentlich zur hochwertigen Atmosphäre im Deimann Spa beiträgt.

- Sie arbeiten selbstständig, zuverlässig und verantwortungsbewusst, damit sich unsere Gäste jederzeit auf Ihre fachliche und persönliche Betreuung verlassen können.

- Sie bringen Flexibilität und Bereitschaft zur Arbeit an Sonn- und Feiertagen mit, da unser Spa auch an diesen Tagen für unsere Gäste geöffnet ist.

title: Senior Product Manager - Productization (m/w/d)
description:
Die Rolle

Wir haben in den letzten Jahren gezeigt, dass wir echte Kundenprobleme lösen können. Jetzt geht es darum, aus bewährten Lösungen wiederholbare Produkte zu machen, die sich skalierbar verkaufen und liefern lassen. Genau dafür suchen wir Dich!

Du machst aus validierten Kundenlösungen skalierbare Produkte. Unser Product-Modell folgt drei Phasen: 0→1 (Kundenproblem verstehen, Lösung im Kundenfall beweisen), 1→n (daraus ein wiederholbares Produkt machen) und n (skalierbar verkaufen, liefern, weiterentwickeln).

Dein Fokus liegt auf 1→ n1→n: Du klärst, was das Produkt ist, für wen, welchen messbaren Mehrwert es liefert und wie es als Standardangebot verkauft und geliefert wird. Du verantwortest Produkt und Produktisierung – Engineering, Delivery, Sales und Product Marketing bleiben für Umsetzung, Kundenprojekt, Opportunity und Vermarktung zuständig. Darüber hinaus verantwortest Du den Lifecycle bestehender Produkte: Du sicherst ihre Stärken und Standards und entwickelst sie gezielt weiter.

Deine Aufgaben:

- Validierte Lösungen konsequent in wiederholbare, standardisierte Angebote überführen

- Zielkunden, Pain, Business Value und Value Proposition schärfen

- Klaren Standardumfang und klare Produktgrenzen definieren – inklusive dessen, was bewusst nicht dazugehört

- Gemeinsam mit Engineering die notwendige Produktreife herstellen

- Kundenfeedback pragmatisch in Produktentscheidungen übersetzen

- Product Marketing die fachliche Grundlage für Positionierung, Messaging und Content geben

- Sales und Presales befähigen, das Produkt ohne permanente Product-Unterstützung zu erklären und zu verkaufen

- Delivery befähigen, Einführung und Betrieb mit kalkulierbarem Aufwand umzusetzen

- Lifecycle, Weiterentwicklung und Priorisierung verantworten, für neu produktisierte ebenso wie für bestehende Produkte, deren Stärken und Standards es zu sichern gilt

Was Du mitbringst

- 5+ Jahre relevante Erfahrung im Product Management im komplexen B2B- bzw. Enterprise-Software-Umfeld

- Nachweisbare Erfahrung darin, aus individuellen Kundenanforderungen, Piloten oder Prototypen ein standardisiertes, wiederholbares Produkt zu machen

- Sehr gutes technisches Verständnis für komplexe Software-, Daten- und AI-Produkte: Du arbeitest mit Engineering auf Augenhöhe und verbindest Business, Kunde, Produkt und Technologie – ohne selbst Engineer sein zu müssen

- Pragmatische Arbeitsweise mit starkem 80/20-Schnitt und schneller Entscheidungsfähigkeit auch bei unvollständigen Informationen, getragen von fundierter methodischer Product-Erfahrung

- Hohe Ownership: Risiken früh erkennen und mit einer klaren Empfehlung kommen statt mit der Bitte um mehr Zeit oder Ressourcen

- Klarer Fokus auf Business Value und Ergebnisse statt auf Prozesse, mit dem Talent, Komplexität zu reduzieren

- Von Vorteil: Erfahrung mit Industriekunden oder Enterprise-Lösungen wie Manufacturing, PLM, ERP, SCM oder Data

- Reisebereitschaft für Kundentermine vor Ort

- Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Was die Rolle nicht ist

Damit Du einschätzen kannst, ob die Rolle zu Dir passt: Wir suchen bewusst nicht

- einen klassischen Product Owner mit Schwerpunkt Backlog und Tickets,

- einen reinen Projektmanager,

- einen weiteren 0→1-Innovator,

- einen Presales-Spezialisten,

- einen reinen Strategen,

- einen technischen Product Manager, der primär in Features und Architektur denkt.

Benefits:

- Echte Gestaltungsverantwortung: Du prägst eine neu definierte Rolle und unser Product-Betriebsmodell für 2027 und darüber hinaus

- Kurze Wege: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Geschäftsführung, Engineering, Sales und Delivery

- Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeiten, flexible Arbeitszeiten und 30 Tage Urlaub

- Modernes Umfeld: Büro im Münchner Werksviertel (House of Communication), moderne Ausstattung und internationale, diverse Teams

- Entwicklung & Kultur: Regelmäßiges Feedback, flache Hierarchien und kollaborative Zusammenarbeit

- Plus: Spendit Card, Urban Sports Club oder EGYM Wellpass, kostenlose Getränke, Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Kaffee & Obst sowie Team- und Office-Events

title: (Senior) Sales / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)

- Reisebereitschaft: Persönliche Kund:innen- und Agenturtermine sowie Messen und Branchenevents gehören für Dich selbstverständlich zum Sales dazu.

Was wir Dir bieten können: 

High-Growth Story – bonial ist ein wachstumsstarkes und dynamisches Unternehmen mit dauerhaftem Potenzial für die Zukunft. Wir sind eines der führenden Unternehmen und eine treibende Kraft in einer Branche, die gerade einen massiven, einmaligen Wandel von Print zu Digital erlebt. 

Innovation & Tech – Wir sind ein High-Tech-Unternehmen mit Fokus auf innovative Technologien. Wir nutzen KI und andere Tools, um Produktivität und Effizienz zu steigern. Damit verbessern wir kontinuierlich die Leistung unseres Unternehmens und aller, die hier arbeiten – und erzielen gleichzeitig Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen und Nutzer:innen.
Spannendes Umfeld für Deine berufliche Entwicklung – Wir unterstützen Dich stark in Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung, gestützt von einer Feedback-Kultur, die Dir hilft, Deine Stärken und Chancen zu erkennen.

Wir setzten uns für gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten ein, und dafür, ein Safe Space zu sein unabhängig von ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Alter, Behinderung, Gender, Geschlechtsidentität oder Geschlechtsausdruck.

Außerdem brauchst Du Dir keine Sorgen um Deine Rente machen, denn wir bezuschussen Deine betriebliche Altersvorsorge. Zusätzlich zu unserem internen Fitnesstudio, übernehmen wir auch einen Teil der Kosten für Urban Sports Club.

Zusammen mit unserem Green Team bieten wir Dir die Möglichkeit, Dich in Projekten zu Nachhaltigkeit und Umweltschutz zu engagieren. Soziale Kultur - Ein gutes Miteinander ist uns wichtig, weshalb wir Wert auf eine Kultur legen, die dazu einlädt, miteinander ins Gespräch zu kommen, gute Arbeitsbeziehungen aufzubauen und sich gemeinschaftlich an Projekten zu beteiligen. Wir bieten außerdem regelmäßig optionale Events an, um dies weiter zu unterstützen. 

Partner für den Handel – Wir ermöglichen es Händler:innen, ihre Kund:innen auf die effizienteste und wirkungsvollste Weise zu erreichen. Wir sehen uns als wichtigen Geschäftspartner für den Handel und – wie in unserer Unternehmensvision betont – „Bereichern wir das lokale Einkaufen für alle. Jeden Tag.“ 

Als Teil der Axel Springer Gruppe orientieren wir uns zusätzlich an den Axel Springer Essentials .

title: Founding Engineer (Remote or Hybrid - EEA/UK)
description:
Founding Engineer

Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices. 

Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us.

About Tarebase 

We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it.

Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people.

Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us.

About you 

The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on. 

You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build.

You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes.

You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship.

You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up.

You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early.

How to apply 

Apply with the button on this page. 

Please ensure to use a hand-written CV. We read every application ourselves. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice.

Our process 

The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability. 

- Application review. If we love your resume we will send over some short questions. 

- Intro call with Dom and Felix. An informal conversation about the role, the technology and what you're looking for.

- Technical deep dive with Felix. We talk briefly about a system you’ve worked on (no need to share anything confidential), then work through a system design problem together.

- Half a day with us in Munich or London. We cover your travel, hotel if needed, and meals. You spend about two hours on a made-up task similar to the problems we work on, using your usual tools and coding agents. Then we have lunch, go through your work together, and talk through a customer scenario.

- References and offer. We speak with 1-2 people you've worked with (only with your agreement) and aim to decide within 48 hours.

If we don't move forward after the technical conversation or later, we'll share some feedback with you.

Compensation : €100.000–120.000 base salary plus 0.75–1% equity

Setup: A MacBook Pro and whatever else you need to work well. If you'd rather not work from home, we'll pay for a coworking space near you.

Location : Munich or London, or remote within Europe (GMT-1 to GMT+3) with regular meet-ups.

title: Senior Product Analyst (w/m/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Wir suchen eine:n Senior Product Analyst, der/die analytische Präzision mit einem ausgeprägten Produktgespür verbindet. Du entscheidest auf Basis von Daten. Du wirst echte Nutzerprobleme auf Grundlage qualitativer und quantitativer Daten herausarbeiten, eine Einschätzung dazu entwickeln, was sich ändern sollte, das passende Experiment aufsetzen und die Ergebnisse selbst analysieren.

Du bist Teil eines Product-Teams, das sich auf einen Teil der User Journey fokussiert, und arbeitest eng mit der Person zusammen, die für diesen Bereich verantwortlich ist, sowie mit den Entwickler:innen, die daran bauen. Du schließt dich einer Gruppe von Conversion Analysts im Unternehmen an, die genauso arbeiten, und bringst eine Perspektive und Erfahrung mit, von der das gesamte Team lernen wird.

Unser Produkt ist ausschließlich für den deutschsprachigen Markt. Um unsere Nutzer:innen wirklich zu verstehen und für sie zu gestalten, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse unerlässlich. Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im Team sind ebenfalls erforderlich.

Das wirst du konkret tun:

- Das eigentliche Problem identifizieren, bevor du es löst. In quantitative und qualitative Daten eintauchen, bis du die wirkliche Frage hinter dem Auftrag findest. Sie dann verständlich und handlungsleitend machen. Ein gut formuliertes Problem ist die halbe Lösung.

- Das Experiment aufsetzen, ehrlich lesen und entscheiden, was als nächstes kommt. Eine testbare Veränderung definieren, sie sauber instrumentieren und das Ergebnis analysieren. Dann das Gelernte nutzen, um die nächste Frage zu formulieren. Das schließt ein, auch über Tests zu berichten, die nicht funktioniert haben, und den nächsten Schritt zu gestalten.

- KI einsetzen und dein Urteil dort einbringen, wo es zählt. KI unterstützt viele unserer ersten Entwürfe. Du wirst sie briefen, hinterfragen und die Qualität sichern – damit deine eigene Zeit für das Denken bleibt, das ein Modell nicht leisten kann.

- Für das Weglassen argumentieren. Hinzufügen ist einfach. Du wirst mitentscheiden, was seinen Platz verdient und was entfernt werden sollte – und bereit sein, dafür einzustehen.

- Mit Nachbar:innen sprechen. Experimente sagen dir, was passiert ist – nicht, was Menschen gebraucht hätten. Du wirst echte Zeit mit den Menschen verbringen, die das Produkt nutzen, weil man sich kein Verständnis für andere durch A/B-Tests erarbeiten kann.

- Erfahrungen gestalten, die auf echten Nutzerbedürfnissen und echtem Nachbarschaftsleben basieren. Dein Job ist es, zu Flows und Screens beizutragen, die intuitiv nutzbar sind und ihren Platz durch messbaren Mehrwert rechtfertigen.

Dein Profil

- Du hast einen ausgeprägten Produktsinn und arbeitest datengetrieben. Dein Hintergrund kann verschieden sein – Product Analytics, CRO, Growth Engineering, oder eine hybridere Rolle aus Produkt oder Design – solange du weißt, wie man Hypothesen schärft, Experimente aufsetzt und Ergebnisse in Entscheidungen übersetzt.

- Du hast Experimente von Anfang bis Ende durchgeführt und weißt, wie du von einem zum nächsten kommst: Hypothese aufstellen, starke Varianten entwickeln, die richtigen Metriken festlegen, Ergebnisse analysieren und eine klare Entscheidung treffen – launchen, verwerfen oder iterieren.

- Du hast technisches Know-how und Erfahrung im Aufsetzen und Auswerten von Experimenten in einem A/B-Testing-Tool sowie im Erstellen der dafür notwendigen Dashboards.

- Du holst dir deine Zahlen selbst per SQL-Abfrage. Du arbeitest mit Rohdaten, um Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und Chancen zu identifizieren – ohne auf andere warten zu müssen.

- Du hast statistische Grundkenntnisse. Du musst kein R beherrschen, aber du verstehst, worum es bei Bayesianischer vs. frequentistischer Statistik geht und warum man vor dem Start eines Experiments eine Power-Analyse durchführt.

- Du präsentierst deine Arbeit klar, verteidigst deine Entscheidungen, wenn sie hinterfragt werden, und bist sicher vor einem Publikum.

- Du arbeitest routiniert mit KI-Tools. Diese Rolle gibt dir mehr Einfluss und Kontrolle – aber dafür musst du unseren AI-Enablement-Stack nutzen und weiterentwickeln können.

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind erforderlich – du wirst Texte und Flows für deutschsprachige Nutzer:innen gestalten und bewerten.

- Gute Englischkenntnisse für die Zusammenarbeit im internationalen Team.

Bitte schick uns ein Anschreiben, in dem du erklärst, warum diese Rolle und warum jetzt – und beschreibe mindestens ein Projekt, das du von Anfang bis Ende erläuterst: die Hypothese, was du getestet hast, das Ergebnis und was du daraus mitgenommen hast. Zeig uns, wie du Daten genutzt hast, um dein Denken voranzubringen, und wo Experimente das beeinflusst haben, was du gebaut hast.

Was wir bieten

- Ein hybrides Arbeitsmodell, das mindestens zwei Bürotage mit Remote-Arbeit kombiniert.

- Einen sinnstiftenden Job – wir schaffen ein großartiges Produkt mit echtem Mehrwert für die Gemeinschaft

- Mitarbeit in einem fröhlichen und erfahrenen Team, das sich austauscht und voneinander lernt

- Einblick in den gesamten Arbeitsprozess unseres Social Startups sowie der Stiftung

- Verantwortung und große Möglichkeiten, dich aktiv einzubringen

- Deine SpenditCard – pro Monat erhältst du ein zusätzliches Einkommen von 35 Euro, das du für Dinge deiner Wahl einsetzen kannst

- 30 Tage Urlaub pro Jahr – außerdem bieten wir die Möglichkeit von Workation-Modellen sowie eines Sabbaticals

title: (Senior) Technical Program Manager - M&A Integration(m/f/d)- Hamburg
description:
Location : Come and join us in Hamburg or Berlin! 

Following Lyft’s acquisition of Freenow, we are looking for a Senior TPM to lead the technical workstreams that get us to Day 1 readiness — the period between signing and closing — and to set up the integration that follows. This is a high-stakes, high-visibility role reporting into the EU Tech Leader, with direct exposure to Freenow and Lyft leadership.

You will be the single point of accountability for technical Day 1 readiness. That means making sure every employee, every office, and every critical system is ready to operate underFreenow by Lyft from the moment the deal closes — and that the integration stream is up and running the day after. You will also be the TPM accountable for the integration of future acquisitions Freenow makes.

This is not a role for someone who wants to administer a project plan. You are expected to be technically credible, opinionated, and comfortable holding senior people to account across IT, Security, Infrastructure, Engineering, Legal, People, and Finance. You make decisions when others stall, escalate cleanly when you can’t, and keep the whole machine moving.

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE: 

- Day 1 readiness. Own the end-to-end technical readiness plan between signing and closing. Define what “ready” means, track every workstream against it, and call the go/no-go on technical readiness for Day 1.

- IT and workplace cutover. Coordinate identity and system access (SSO, IdP, mail, productivity suite, engineering tooling), hardware provisioning and re-imaging, and office setup including network, VPN, Wi-Fi, meeting rooms, and physical access. Make sure nobody shows up on Day 1 unable to work.

- Security and compliance posture. Partner with Security and Legal to make sure the technical environment meets the new shareholder’s requirements on Day 1 — access controls, data handling, audit trails, vendor relationships.

- Integration stream kickoff. Stand up the technical integration workstreams between Freenow and Lyft so they are running, staffed, and producing output from day one of the integration phase. Set the operating cadence, dependencies, and escalation paths.

- Cross-functional orchestration. Hold IT, SRE, Infrastructure, Platform, Product Engineering, Data, Security, People, Legal, and Finance together on a single plan. Push hard on dependencies. Surface risks before they become incidents.

- Executive communication. Produce the technical readiness narrative for Freenow leadership, Lyft leadership, and the integration steering committee. Honest, concise, decision-oriented.

- Future M&A. Codify what you learn into a repeatable M&A integration playbook so we can do this faster and better the next time Freenow acquires a company.

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE: 

- Significant TPM, engineering management, or M&A integration experience, with a clear track record of delivering on M&A separation, integration, or carve-out programmes — ideally including a Day 1 cutover under a new owner.

- A strong technical foundation — software engineering or infrastructure background. You can sit in an architecture review and push back credibly, and you understand what it takes to operate large-scale, 24x7 production systems.

- Working knowledge of enterprise IT and corporate engineering: identity providers and SSO, MDM, endpoint management, networking and VPN, SaaS provisioning, source control and CI/CD tooling, cloud account structures.

- Comfort operating in extreme ambiguity with only high-level direction, across multiple jurisdictions, time zones, and corporate cultures.

- Excellent written and verbal communication in English. You can brief a C-level audience in three slides and an engineer in a Slack thread, and adjust the register without losing precision.

- Influence without authority. You get senior people to commit, deliver, and stay aligned in a matrixed environment — without needing a reporting line to do it.

- Calm under pressure. M&A timelines move, regulators ask questions, and things break. You stay structured and keep others structured.

Nice to have: 

- Previous experience inside a regulated business (mobility, fintech, payments) or working through a change-of-control event.

- Familiarity with the German labour and works council context.

- Exposure to both acquirer-side and target-side integration work.

BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL: 

- Flexible working arrangements

- LinkedIn Learning

- Sabbatical & special leave policies

- WeRoad partnership

- Birthday, 24th + 31st December off

- Short term EU work policy

- Mobility Credit

- Health Insurance

- Employee assistance program

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION: 

Freenow is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age. 
We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work . 

ABOUT US: 

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app. 

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?
